text: Diluns, de scientifics de l'escòla de medecina de l'Universitat Stanford anoncièron l'invencion d'un novèl esplech de diagnostic que pòt triar las cellulas per tipe: una nièra minuscula imprimibla que pòt èsser manufacturada en utilizar d'estampadoiras de get de tencha per un còst possiblament a l'entorn d'un cent american caduna.
eng_text: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Los cercaires principals afirman qu'aquò pòt portar a una deteccion precòça del cancèr, de la tuberculòsi, del SIDA e de la malària en çò dels pacients dels païses de revenguts febles, ont lo taus de subrevida per de malautiás coma lo cancèr del pitre pòt representar la mitat del dels païses mai rics.
eng_text: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Lo JAS 39C Gripen s'espotiguèt sus una pista a l'entorn de 9:30 del matin ora locala (02:30 UTC) e explosèt, çò que barrèt l'aeropòrt als vòls comercials.
eng_text: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Lo pilòt foguèt identificat coma lo cap d'esquadron Dilokrit Pattawee.
eng_text: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Los mejans de comunicacion locals senhalan qu'un veïcul de pompièrs de l'aeropòrt s'es virabocat mentre qu'interveniá.
eng_text: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal, de 28 ans, rejonhèt lo Barça fa tres sasons, dempuèi Sevilla.
eng_text: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Dempuèi son installacion dins la capitala catalana, Vidal a jogat 49 partidas amb lo club.
eng_text: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: La manifestacion comencèt a l'entorn de 11:00 ora locala (UTC + 1) a Whitehall, en fàcia de l'intrada susvelhada per la polícia de Downing Street, la residéncia oficiala del Primièr ministre.
eng_text: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Just aprèp 11 oras, los protestaires bloquèron la circulacion sus la via que va al nòrd a Whitehall.
eng_text: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: A 11:20, la polícia demandèt als manifestants de se desplaçar tornarmai sul trepador, en declarar que fasiá mestièr de crear un equilibri entre lo drech de manifestar e la circulacion qu'aumentava.
eng_text: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: A l’entorn de 11:29, la manifestacion se desplacèt amont de Whitehall, enlà de Trafalgar Square, long del Strand, en passar per Aldwych e en montant Kingsway cap a Holborn ont lo Partit Conservador èra a tenir son Forum de Prima dins l'otèl Grand Connaught Rooms.
eng_text: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Lo recòrd cap a cap de Nadal contra lo canadian es de 7–2.
eng_text: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Perdèt recentament contra Raonic a l’Open de Brisbane.
eng_text: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal empochèt 88% de ponches nets dins la partida en ganhar 76 ponches durant lo primièr servici.
eng_text: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Aprèp la partida, lo Rei de la tèrra batuda diguèt, "Soi tot bèl just estrambordat d'èsser tornat per las sèrias finalas de las competicions pus importantas. Soi aicí per ensajar de ganhar aquò."
eng_text: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: Los "Panama Papers" es un tèrme generic per gaireben dètz milions de documents del cabinet legal panamenc Mossack Fonseca, que filtrèt dins la premsa durant la prima de 2016.
eng_text: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Los documents mostrèron catòrze bancas qu'ajudèron de clients rics a amagar de miliards de dolars americans de fortuna per evitar los impòstes e d'autras regulacions.
eng_text: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Lo jornal britanic The Guardian suggeriguèt que Deutsche Bank contrarotlava a l'entorn d'un tèrç de las 1200 societats ecran utilizadas per capitar aquò.
eng_text: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: I aguèt de manifestacions dins lo mond entièr, divèrsas enseguidas criminalas, e los caps dels govèrns d'Islàndia e Paquistan demissionèron totes dos.
eng_text: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Nascut a Hong Kong, Ma estudièt a l’Universitat de Nòva York e a la Facultat de drech d'Harvard e tenguèt anteriorament una "carta verda" americana de resident permanent.
eng_text: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh faguèt comprendre pendent las eleccions que Ma podriá fugir del país durant un temps de crisi.
eng_text: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh argumentèt tanben que lo fotogenic Ma èra mai un estil que de substància.
eng_text: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Malgrat aquestas acusacions, Ma ganhèt facilament amb una plataforma que preconizava de ligams mai estreches amb la China continentala.
eng_text: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Lo Jogaire del Jorn d’uèi es Alex Ovechkin dels Washington Capitals.
eng_text: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Faguèt 2 buts e 2 passas decisivas per la victòria de Washington de 5-3 contra los Atlanta Thrashers.
eng_text: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: La primièra passa decisiva de la nuèch d'Ovechkin foguèt sul but de la victòria del novèl recrutat Nicklas Backstrom;
eng_text: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: son segond but de la nuèch foguèt lo 60n de la sason, e venguèt aital lo primièr jogaire a marcar 60 buts o mai dins una sason dempuèi 1995-96, quand Jaromir Jagr e Mario Lemieux atenhèron cadun aquel nivèl prestigis.
eng_text: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten èra classat 190n sus la lista de 2008 dels 400 americans mai rics amb una fortuna estimada de 2,3 miliards de dolars.
eng_text: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Se diplomèt al College of Arts & Sciences de l’Universitat de Virgínia en 1950 e foguèt un donaire significatiu a aquela institucion.
eng_text: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: La preson iraquiana d’Abu Ghraib es estada incendiada pendent una susmauta.
eng_text: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: La preson venguèt notòria aprèp que la violéncia contra los presonièrs foguèt descobèrta aprèp que las fòrças americanas ne prenguèssen lo contraròtle.
eng_text: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr. s'espotiguèt pendent lo Grand Prix de Singapor de 2008 just aprèp un arrèst a l'stand d'ora per Fernando Alonso, que faguèt sortir la veitura de seguretat.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Estant que las veituras davant Alonso anèron metre de carburant jos la veitura de seguretat, remontèt lo peloton per emportar la victòria.
eng_text: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr. foguèt escampat après lo Grand Prix d'Ongria en 2009.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: A exactament 8:46 del matin, un silenci tombèt sus la vila, marcant lo moment exacte que lo primièr jet tustèt sa tòca.
eng_text: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Dos gets de lum son estats installats per ponchejar cap al cèl la nuèch passada.
eng_text: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: La construccion de cinc gratacèls novèls es en cors sul sit, amb un centre de transpòrt e un parc commemoratiu al mièg.
eng_text: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Lo programa PBS a mai de doas dotzenas de prèmis Emmy, e sa durada es sonque mai corta que la de Sesame Street e Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
eng_text: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Cada episòdi del programa se concentrariá sus un tèma dins un libre especific e explorariá puèi aquel tèma a travèrs d'istòrias multiplas.
eng_text: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Cada emission forniriá tanben de recomandacions suls libres que los enfants deurián cercar quand anirián a lor bibliotèca.
eng_text: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, de WNED Buffalo (l'estacion d'acuèlh de Reading Rainbow) diguèt: "Reading Rainbow ensenhèt als mainatges perqué legir,... l'amor de la lectura — [lo programa] encoratgèt los mainatges a causir un libre e a lo legir."
eng_text: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: D'unes creson, John Grant comprés, qu'a l’encòp lo mermament de finançament e un desaviament dins la filosofia e la programacion televisuala educativa contribuguèron a la fin de la sèria.
eng_text: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Es probable que la tempèsta, situada a l'entorn de 645 milas (1040 km) a l'oèst de las islas de Cap Verd, se dissipe abans de menaçar de zònas terrèstras, segon las previsions meteorologicas.
eng_text: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred a actualament de vents de 105 milas per ora (165 km/h) e se desplaça cap al nòrd-oèst.
eng_text: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred es lo ciclon tropical mai potent enregistrat jamai fins ara al sud e a l'èst de l'Atlantic dempuèi l'aparicion de l’imatjariá per satellit, e sonque lo tresen auragan mai important enregistrat a l'èst de 35°W.
eng_text: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Lo 24 de setembre de 1759, Arthur Guinness signèt un arrendament de 9 000 ans per la braçariá de St James' Gate a Dublin, en Irlanda.
eng_text: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: 250 ans mai tard, Guinness a crescut fins a una entrepresa mondiala que ganha 10 miliards d’èuros (14,7 miliards de dolars americans) cada annada.
eng_text: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, copilòt de l'equipa de Nòva Zelanda a l'A1GP, a fach istòria uèi en condusent lo mai rapidament sul pont del pòrt neozelandés d'Auckland, qu'a 48 ans, legalament.
eng_text: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Sr. Reid capitèt de menar la veitura neozelandesa de l'A1GP, Black Beauty a de velocitats superioras a 160km/h sèt còps sul pont.
eng_text: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: La polícia neozelandesa aguèt de problèmas per utilizar sos radars portables per veire la velocitat que se desplaçava Sénher Reid per encausa de la bassesa de sa Black Beauty, e lo sol còp que la polícia poguèt cronometrar Sénher Reid foguèt quand alentiguèt sa velocitat fins a 160 km/h.
eng_text: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Pendent los 3 darrièrs meses, mai de 80 personas arrestadas foguèron liberadas de l'installacion de Central Booking sens èsser inculpadas formalament.
eng_text: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: En abril ongan, un òrdre de restrencha temporària foguèt emés pel jutge Glynn contra l'establiment per far aplicar la liberacion de las personas detengudas mai de 24 oras aprèp lor admission qu'èran pas estadas ausidas per un commissari del tribunal.
eng_text: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Lo comissari fixa la caucion, s'es acordada, e formaliza las acusacions presentadas per l'agent de detencion. Las acusacions son puèi sasidas dins lo sistèma informatic de l'estat ont se fa un seguiment del cas.
eng_text: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: L’audiéncia marca tanben la data del drech del suspècte a un procès rapid.
eng_text: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, lo tresaurièr australian e l'òme mai susceptible de succedir al Primièr ministre John Howard coma cap del Partit Liberal a donat son supòrt a una industria nucleara en Austràlia.
eng_text: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Sr. Costello diguèt que quand la generacion d'energia nucleara vendrà viabla economicament, Austràlia deuriá cercar a l'emplegar.
eng_text: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Se ven comercial, o deuriam aver. Es a dire que i a pas de principi a l'energia nucleara" afirmèt Sr. Costello.
eng_text: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Segon Ansa, "la polícia èra preocupada per un parelh d'atacas de naut nivèl e avián paur que poguèssen engendrar una guèrra obèrta de succession.
eng_text: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: La polícia afirmèt que Lo Piccolo aviá l'avantatge perque èra estat lo braç drech de Provenzano a Palèrm e son experiéncia mai granda li aviá ganhat lo respècte de la generacion mai anciana dels caps estent que seguissián la politica de Provenzano de gardar un perfil tan bas coma èra possible mentre que consolidava sa ret de poder.
eng_text: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Aquestes caps èran estats frenats per Provenzano quand aviá mes fin a la guèrra menada per Riina contra l'Estat que costèt la vida als crosats de la màfia Giovanni Falcone e Paolo Borsellino en 1992."
eng_text: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Steve Jobs, lo PDG d’Apple desvelèt lo dispositiu tot caminant sus la scèna e en sortissent l'iPhone de la pòcha de son jeans.
eng_text: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Pendent son discors de 2 oras declarèt que "Uèi Apple es a reinventar lo telefòn, Anam far l'istòria uèi".
eng_text: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Brasil es lo país catolic roman mai important sus Tèrra, e la glèisa catolica romana s’es opausada consistentament a la legalizacion del maridatge omosexual dins lo país.
eng_text: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Lo Congrès Nacional de Brasil a debatut aquesta legalizacion pendent 10 ans, e de tals maridatges civils son sonque legals actualament dins lo Rio Grande do Sul.
eng_text: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Lo projècte de lei original foguèt redigit per l'ancian cònsol de São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. La legislacion prepausada, après sos emendaments, es ara dins las mans de Roberto Jefferson.
eng_text: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Los manifestants espèran de reculhir una peticion de 1,2 milions de signaturas per la presentar al Congrès Nacional en novembre.
eng_text: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Aprèp que venguèsse evident que fòrça familhas cercavan d’ajuda legala per combatre las expulsions, una reünion se tenguèt lo 20 de març a l’East Bay Community Law Center per las victimas de l'engana del lotjament.
eng_text: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Quand los logataris comencèron a escambiar çò que lor èra passat, la màger part de las familhas implicadas realizèt subran que Carolyn Wilson de l’OHA aviá raubat lors depauses de seguretat, e s'èra esbinhada de la vila.
eng_text: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Los logataris de Lockwood Gardens creson qu'i podriá aver 40 autras familhas o mai que van far fàcia a l'expulsion, estent qu'an aprés que la polícia de l'OHA enquestava tanben sus d'autras proprietats de lotjament public a Oakland que podrián èsser de victimas de l'engana del lotjament.
eng_text: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Lo grop anullèt son espectacle al War Memorial Stadium de Maui, lo qual èra preparat per aculhir 9 000 personas, e presentèron sas excusas als fans.
eng_text: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: La companhiá que pòrta la gestion del grop, HK Management Inc., donèt pas cap de rason inicialament quand anullèron lo 20 de setembre, mas blasmèt de rasons logisticas l'endeman.
eng_text: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Los famoses avocats grècs, Sakis Kechagioglou e George Nikolakopoulos, son estats empresonats dins la preson d'Atenas de Korydallus, estent que foguèron trobats colpables de delictes penals e corrupcion.
eng_text: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: En resulta d’aquò, un grand escàndol al sen de la comunitat legala grèga s'elevèt a travèrs l'exposicion d’actes illegals que los jutges, los avocats, los notaris e los mandataris avián faches durant las annadas anterioras.
eng_text: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Fa qualques setmanas, aprèp la publicacion de las informacions del jornalista Makis Triantafylopoulos dins son programa popular de television "Zoungla" sus Alpha TV, lo membre del Parlament e avocat, Petros Mantouvalos foguèt demés de sas foncions estent que de membres de son cabinet èran estats implicats dins de presas d'interès illegalas e de corrupcion.
eng_text: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: A mai, lo jutge principal Evangelos Kalousis es empresonat qu'es estat trobat colpable de corrupcion e de comportament indecent.
eng_text: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts refusèt categoricament de dire quand crei que la vida comença, una question importanta quand se considera l’etica de l’avortament, afirmant que seriá contrari a l’etica de comentar los detalhs de cases probables.
eng_text: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Reiterèt, pasmens, sa declaracion anteriorament que Roe v. Wade èra la "lei establida del país", en insistissent sus l’importància de la coeréncia dins las decisions de la Cort Suprèma.
eng_text: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Confirmèt tanben que cresiá al drech a la privacitat implicita que ne dependiá la decision Roe.
eng_text: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore aviá acabat a la cima de l'escala, amb sièis ponches d'avança sus Noosa lo segond.
eng_text: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Los dos costats se retrobarián dins la semifinala principala ont Noosa aganiguèt los ganhaires per 11 ponches.
eng_text: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore vencèt puèi Caboolture dins la finala preliminària.
eng_text: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae es una espécia de la familha dels Dromaeosauridae e es un cosin del velociraptor.
eng_text: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Se crei qu’aqueste aucèl de presa de sang caud, plen de plumas, caminava quilhat sus sas doas cambas amb d’arpas coma lo velociraptor.
eng_text: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Sa segonda arpa èra mai granda, e donèt lòc al nom Hesperonychus que significa "arpa occidentala."
eng_text: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: A mai del glaç brigalhadís, las condicions meteorologicas extrèmas an entrepachat los esfòrces de socors.
eng_text: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittman suggeriguèt que las condicions melhorarián pas fins a un moment de la setmana venenta.
eng_text: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: La quantitat e l'espessor de la banquisa, segon Pittman, es lo piéger qu'es estat pels sagelaires dins los darrièrs 15 ans.
eng_text: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: D'informacions se propaguèron dins la comunitat de Red Lake uèi estent que las funeralhas de Jeff Weise e de tres de las nòu victimas se tenguèron qu'un autre estudiant èra estat arrestat a prepaus de las fusilhadas a l'escòla del 21 de març.
eng_text: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Las autoritats diguèron pas grand causa oficialament en defòra de confirmar l’arrestacion d’uèi.
eng_text: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Pasmens, una font amb coneissença de l'enquèsta diguèt al Minneapolis Star-Tribuna qu'èra Louis Jourdain, lo filh de 16 ans del president de la tribú de Red Lake Floyd Jourdain.
eng_text: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

eng_text: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

eng_text: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: Una copadura d’electricitat en seguida d'un test de rotina del sistèma de centre de comanda causèt l'obertura de valvas de seguretat e lo petròli brut desbordèt a ras de l’estacion de pompatge 9 de Fort Greely.
eng_text: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: L’obertura de las valvas permetèt de liberar la pression sul sistèma e lo petròli ragèt sus un tampon cap a una sèrva que pòt encabir 55 000 barrils (2,3 milions de galons).
eng_text: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: La tantossada de dimècres, los espiralhs de la sèrva contunhavan de rajar probablament per encausa de l’expansion termala a l’interior de la sèrva.
eng_text: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Una autra zòna de contencion segondària jos las sèrvas capabla de tenir 104.500 barrils èra pas encara completament emplenada.

text: Los comentaris, en dirècte a la television, representavan lo primièr còp que de fons nautas iranianas avián admés que las sancions avián d'efièches.

eng_text: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

eng_text: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Quand la capsula arribarà sus Tèrra e dintrarà dins l’atmosfèra, a aperaquí 5 oras del matin (ora de l'èst), es previst que faga un espectacle luminós per las gents del nòrd de Califòrnia, Oregon, Nevada, e Utah.
eng_text: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: La capsula se semblarà fòrça a una estela fugidissa que travèrsa lo cèl.
eng_text: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: La capsula viatjarà a aperaquí 12,8 km o 8 milas per segonda, pro rapidament per anar de San Francisco a Los Angeles en una minuta.
eng_text: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

eng_text: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Lo mes passat, i aviá de manifestacions importantas en Polonha quand lo país signèt l'ACTA, çò qu'a portat lo govèrn polonés a decidir de ratificar pas l'acòrd, per ara.
eng_text: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Letònia e Eslovaquia an retardat totas doas lo procès per rejónher l'ACTA.
eng_text: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Animal Liberation e la Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) demandan encara l’installacion obligatòria de camèras CCTV dins totes los tuadors australians.
eng_text: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: L'inspector en cap de la RSPCA de New South Wales, David O'Shannessy, declarèt a ABC que la susvelhança e las inspeccions dins los tuadors deurián èsser correntas en Austràlia.
eng_text: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: "La videosusvelhança enviariá sens dobte un senhal fòrt a aquelas personas que trabalhan amb d'animals que lor benésser es la prioritat mai nauta."
eng_text: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: La mapa internacionala de tèrratremols de l’Institut d’Estudis Geologics dels Estats Units mostrava pas cap de tèrratremols en Islàndia durant la setmana precedenta.
eng_text: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Lo Burèu meteorologic islandés senhalèt pas tanpauc cap d'activitat sismica dins la region de Hekla durant las darrièras 48 oras.
eng_text: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: L'activitat sismica significativa que provoquèt lo cambiament de fasa se produsiguèt lo 10 de març del costat nòrd-èst de la caldera de la cima del volcan.
eng_text: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: De nívols escuras sens ligam amb tota mena d'activitat volcanica foguèron senhalats a la basa de la montanha.
eng_text: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Las nívols presentèron lo potencial per una confusion per saber s'una erupcion vertadièra s'èra debanada.
eng_text: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Lo Luno aviá 120-160 mètres cubics de carburant a bòrd quand tombèt en pana e los vents fòrt e las èrsas lo butèron cap a la peirada.
eng_text: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: D’elicoptèrs secorreguèron los dotze membres d’equipatge e la sola lesion foguèt un nas petat.
eng_text: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Lo naviri de 100 mètres èra en rota per recuperar sa cargason d'engrais abituala e las autoritats avián paur inicialament que lo naviri ne versèsse una carga.
eng_text: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: L'emendament prepausat foguèt adoptat dins totas doas cambras en 2011.
eng_text: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Un cambiament se faguèt dins aquesta session legislativa quand la segonda frasa foguèt escafada d’en primièr per la Cambra dels Representants e foguèt acceptada puèi jos una forma similara pel Senat lo diluns.
eng_text: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Lo fracàs de la segonda senténcia, que prepausa d'enebir las unions civilas de meteis sèxe, podrián possiblament obrir la pòrta a las unions civilas dins l'avenidor.
eng_text: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: En seguida del procès, HJR-3 serà examinat tornarmai per la legislatura elegida venenta si en 2015 o 2016 per demorar en procès.
eng_text: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Las succèsses de Vautier en defòra de la realizacion comprenon una cauma de la fam en 1973 contra çò que li semblava de censura politica.
eng_text: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: La lei francesa foguèt cambiada. Son activisme remontava a l’edat de 15 ans quand se jonhèt a la resisténcia francesa durant la Segonda Guèrra Mondiala.
eng_text: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Cerquèt los documents dins un libre de 1998.
eng_text: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Dins las annadas 1960 se dirigiguèt tornarmai cap a l’Algèria tot bèl just independenta per i ensenhar la realizacion de films.
eng_text: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Lo judoka japonés Hitoshi Saito, vencedor de doas medalhas olimpicas d'aur, es mòrt a l'edat de 54 ans.
eng_text: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: La causa de la mòrt foguèt anonciada coma un cancèr de las vias biliaras intraepaticas.
eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Moriguèt a Osaka lo dimars.
eng_text: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: A mai d'èsser un ancian campion olimpic e mondial, Saito èra lo director del comitat de formacion de la Federacion japonesa de judo al moment de sa mòrt.
eng_text: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Almens 100 personas avián participat a la fèsta, a fin de celebrar lo primièr aniversari d’un couple que son maridatge s'èra tengut l’an passat.
eng_text: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Una celebracion d'anniversari formala foguèt programada per una data ulteriora, diguèron los oficials.
eng_text: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Fasiá un an que lo parelh s'èra maridat en Tèxas e èran venguts a Buffalo per celebrar amb d'amics e de parents.
eng_text: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Lo marit de 30 ans, qu'èra nascut a Buffalo, foguèt una de las quatre personas tuadas dins la fusilhada, mas sa femna foguèt pas ferida.
eng_text: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno es un tutor d'anglés plan conegut mas controversat que ensenhava als establiments Modern Education e King's Glory que pretendèt aver agut 9 000 estudiants a l'apogèu de sa carrièra.
eng_text: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Dins sas nòtas utilizava de mots que qualques parents consideravan grossièrs, e se ditz qu'emplegava de paraulassas en classa.
eng_text: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education l'acusèt d'imprimir de grandas publicitats suls buses sens autorizacion e de mentir en disent qu'èra lo principal tutor en anglés.
eng_text: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Es estat tanben acusat anteriorament de violacion dels dreches d'autor, mas foguèt pas inculpat.
eng_text: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un ancian estudiant diguèt que 'utilizava d’argòt en classa, ensenhava de competéncias de seduccion amb de nòtas, e qu’èra just coma un amic dels estudiants'.
eng_text: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Durant las darrièras tres decennias, malgrat que demorèsses oficialament un estat comunista, China a desvolopat una economia de mercat.
eng_text: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Las primièras reformas economicas foguèron fachas jos la direccion de Deng Xiaoping.
eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Dempuèi aquel moment, la talha economica de China s'es multiplicada per 90.
eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Pel primièr còp, l'an passat China exportèt mai de veituras qu’Alemanha e subrepassèt los Estats Units coma lo mercat mai important per aquela industria.
eng_text: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Lo PIB de China podriá venir mai elevat que lo dels Estats Units dins doas decennias.
eng_text: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: La tempèsta tropicala Danielle, quatrena tempèsta batejada de la sason dels auragans atlantics de 2010, s’es formada dins la partida orientala de l’Ocean Atlantic.
eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: La tempèsta, situada a aproximativament 3 000 milas de Miami, Florida, a de vents sostenguts de 40 mph (64 km/h).
eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Los scientifics del National Hurricane Center predison que Danielle s'enfortirà per venir un auragan dimècres.
eng_text: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Coma la tempèsta storm es luènh de tocar lo sòl, demòra malaisit de determinar l’impacte potencial suls Estats Units o la Cariba.
eng_text: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Nascut dins la capitala croata, Zagreb, Bobek venguèt famós del temps que jogava pel Partizan Belgrade.
eng_text: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Los rejonhèt en 1945 e demorèt fins a 1958.
eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Durant son temps amb l'equipa, marquèt 403 buts en 468 participacions.
eng_text: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Degun a pas jamai fach mai d'aparicions o marcat mai de but pel club que Bobek.
eng_text: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: En 1995 foguèt elegit melhor jogador de l'istòria del Partizan.
eng_text: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Las celebracions comencèron amb un espectacle especial del grop renomenat mondialament lo Cirque du Soleil.
eng_text: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Foguèt acompanhat per l'Orquèstra Sinfonica d'Estat d'Istanbol, una benda de janissaris e los cantaires Fatih Erkoç e Müslüm Gürses.
eng_text: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Puèi de derviches remolinaires montèron sus scèna.
eng_text: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: La diva turca Sezen Aksu cantèt amb lo tenòr italian Alessandro Safina e lo cantaire grèc Haris Alexiou.
eng_text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Per clavar, lo grop de dança turc Fire of Anatolia realizèt l’espectacle "Troy".
eng_text: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, un corredor de mòto de 13 ans, es mòrt aprèp èsser estat implicat dins un accident sus l'Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Del temps qu’èra a far lo torn d’escaufament, Lenz tombèt de sa motocicleta, e foguèt puèi trucat per son companh de corsa Xavier Zayat.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Foguèt immediatament pres en carga pel personal medical de la pista e transportat dins un espital local ont moriguèt mai tard.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat sortiguèt indemne de l’accident.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Per çò qu'es de la situacion financièra mondiala, Zapatero contunhèt en afirmar que "lo sistèma financièra es una part de l'economia, una part cruciala.
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Sèm dins una crisi financièra dempuèi un an, qu'a agut son moment mai grèu dins los darrièrs dos meses, e pensi qu’ara los mercats financièrs començan a recuperar."
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: La setmana passada, Naked News anoncièt que aumentariá considerablament son autoritat lingüistica internacionala al jornalisme, amb tres novèlas emissions.
eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: L’organizacion mondiala, que fa ja d'informacion en anglés e japonés, es a lançar de programas en lengas espanhòla, italiana, e coreana, per la television, lo web, e los dispositius mobils.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Per astre res se passèt per ieu, mas vegèri una scèna macabra, quand las gents ensajavan de petar las fenèstras pr'amor de sortir.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Las gents èran a tustar suls veires amb de cadièras, mas las fenèstras èran incopablas.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Un dels veires se copèt finalament, e comencèron a sortir per la fenèstra," diguèt Franciszek Kowal, un subrevivent.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Las estelas liberan de lutz e de calor per encausa de l'energia fabricada quand los atòms d'idrogèn son assemblats (o fusionats) per formar d'elements mai pesants.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Los scientifics son a trabalhar per crear un reactor que pòt fabricar d'energia del meteis biais.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Aquò, pasmens, es un problèma de plan mal resòlvre e demandarà fòrça annadas abans que poscam veire la construccion de reactors de fusion utils.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: L'agulha d'acièr flòta sus l'aiga per encausa de la tension de susfàcia.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: La tension de susfàcia se produsís perque las moleculas d'aiga a la susfàcia de l'aiga son fòrtament atiradas las unas amb las autras mai qu'o son a las moleculas d'aire que son dessús d'elas.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Las moleculas d’aiga forman una pèl invisibla sus la susfàcia de l’aiga que permet a de causas coma una agulha de flotar sus l’aiga.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: La lama sus un patin de glaç modèrn a un doble bòrd amb un trauc concau entre eles. Totes dos bòrds permeton una presa melhora sul glaç, e mai quand es inclinada.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Perque lo bas de la lama es leugièrament incurvat, tre que la lama s'inclina cap a un costat o l’autre, la poncha qu'es en contacte amb lo glaç s’incurva tanben.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Aquò fa que lo skater vire. Se lo skate s'inclina cap a man drecha, lo skater vira a drecha, se lo skate s'inclina a man esquèrra, lo skater vira a esquèrra.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Per tornar a lor nivèl d’energia prealable, se devon desfar de l’energia suplementària recebuda de la lutz.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: O fan en emetent una particula minuscula de lutz sonada un "foton".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Los scientifics sonan aqueste procès "emission estimulada de radiacion" perque los atòms son estimulats per la lutz brilhanta, çò que causa l'emission d'un foton luminós, e la lum es un tipe de radiacion.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: L'imatge seguent mòstra los atòms qu'emeton de fotons. Plan segur, en realitat los fotons son fòrça mai pichons que los que i a sus l'imatge.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Los fotons son encara mai pichons que las causas que forman los atòms!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Aprèp de centenats d’oras de foncionament lo filament dins l'ampola s'escantís finalament e l'ampola electrica fonciona pas mai.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Alara l'ampola electrica deu èsser remplaçada. Es necite de far mèfi al moment de remplaçar l'ampola electrica.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: D'en primièr, se deu atudar l’interruptor del luminari o desconnectar lo cable.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Es perque l'electricitat que raja dins la dolha ont la part metallica de l'ampola se plaça vòs pòt causar un chòc electric sevèr se tocatz l'interior de la dolha o la basa metallica de l'ampola mentre es encara parcialament dins la dolha.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: L'organ principal del sistèma circulatòri es lo còr, que pompa lo sang.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Lo sang se'n va del còr dins de tubs que se sonan artérias e torna al còr dins de tubs sonats venas. Los tubs pus pichons se dison capillars.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Las dents d’un triceratòps serián estadas capablas d'esclafar pas sonque de fuèlhas mas tanben de brancas e de rasics plan duras.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Qualques scientifics pensan que los triceratòps manjavan de cicadofitas, que son una mena de plan qu'èra comuna durant lo Cretacèu.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Aquestas plantas semblan un pichon palmièr amb una corona de fuèlhas afiladas e ponchudas.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Un triceratòps auriá pogut utilizar son bèc fòrt per n'arrancar las fuèlhas abans de manjar lo tronc.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: D'autres scientifics afirman qu'aquelas plantas son fòrça enverenadas e que doncas es improbable qu'un dinosaure ne mangèsse, e mai se uèi lo peresós e d'autres animals coma lo papagai (un descendent del dinosaures) pòdon manjar de fuèlhas o de fruches enverenats.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Cossí m'afectariá la gravetat d'Io? Se vos teniatz a la susfàcia d'Io, pesariatz mens qu'o fasètz sus Tèrra.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Una persona que pesa 200 liuras (90kg) sus la Tèrra pesariá aperaquí 36 liuras (16kg) sus Io. Alara la gravetat, plan segur, tira mens sus tu.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Lo Solelh a pas una crosta coma la Tèrra ont vos podètz tenir. Lo Solelh entièr es fach de gases, de fuòc e de plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Lo gas ven mai fin mentre vos alunhatz del centre del Solelh.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: La part exteriora que vesèm quand agacham lo Solelh se sona la fotosfèra, çò que significa "bola de lutz".
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Aperaquí tres mila ans mai tard, en 1610, l’astronòm italian Galileo Galilei utilizèt un telescòpi per observar que Venus a de fasas, just coma la luna.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Las fasas se produsisson perque sonque lo costat de Vènus (o de la Luna) que fa fàcia al Solelh es esclairat. Las fasas de Vènus an provat la teoria de Copernic que las planetas viran a l'entorn del Solelh.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Puèi, qualques ans mai tard en 1639, un astronòm anglés sonat Jeremiah Horrocks observèt un transit de Vènus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Anglatèrra aviá conegut un long periòde de patz aprèp la reconquèsta del Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Pasmens en 991 faguèt fàcia a una flòta viking mai granda que totas las anterioras dempuèi la de Guthrum un sègle abans.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Aquela flòta èra capitanejada per Olaf Trygvasson, un norvegian qu’aviá l’ambicion de recobrar son país de la dominacion danesa.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Après los revèrses militars del començament, Ethelred poguèt far una pacha amb Olaf, que tornèt en Norvègia per ensajar de recuperar son reialme amb un succès mitigat.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul es lo solet alfabet inventat exprèssament per un emplec popular quotidian. Aquel alfabet foguèt inventat en 1444 durant lo regne del rei Sejong (1418 – 1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: King Sejong foguèt lo quatren rei de la dinastia Joseon e es un dels mai nautament apreciats.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: A l'origina nomenèt l’alfabet Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, çò que significa "los sons corrèctes per l’instruccion del pòble".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: I a fòrça teorias sus cossí lo sanscrit venguèt a existir. Una d'elas es a prepaus d'una migracion d'arians de l'oèst dins Índia que portèron lor lenga amb eles.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Lo sanscrit es una lenga anciana e es comparabla a la lenga latina parlada en Euròpa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Lo libre mai ancian conegut del mond entièr foguèt escrich en sanscrit. Après la recopilacion de las Upanishads, lo sanscrit s'esfumèt per encausa de la ierarquia.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Lo sanscrit es una lenga fòrça complèxa e rica, la quala serviguèt coma font de fòrça lengas indianas modèrnas, just coma lo latin es la font de lengas europèas coma lo francés e l’espanhòl.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Aprèp que la batalha per França foguèsse acabada, Alemanha comencèt a s'aprestar a envasir l’isla de Granda Bretanha.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemanha donèt coma nom de còdi a l’ataca “Operacion Leon de mar”. La màger part de las armas pesantas de l’Armada Britanica e de l'equipament èran estat perduts quand faguèt son evacuacion de Dunkirk, e doncas l’armada èra pro flaca.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Mas la Royal Navy èra encara plan mai fòrta que la marina alemanda ("Kriegsmarine") e podriá aver destruch tota flòta d'invasion mandada a travèrs de la Marga anglesa.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Pasmens, fòrça paucs naviris de la Royal Navy èran basats a ras de las rotas probablas d'invasion estent que los amiralhs avián paur d'èsser enfonzats per una ataca aeriana alemanda.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Comencem amb una explicacion suls plans d'Itàlia. Itàlia èra essencialament lo "fraire cabdèt" d'Alemanha e de Japon.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Aviá una armada mai febla e una marina mai febla, e mai s'avián tot just construch quatre novèls vaissèls abans lo començament de la guèrra.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Los objectius principals d’Itàlia èran los païses africans. Per capturar aqueles païses, fasiá mestièr d’aver un ròdol de lançament de tropas, per tal que las tropas poguèssen navegar a travèrs de la Mar Mediterranèa e envasir Africa.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Per aquò, aguèron de se desfar de las basas e dels batèus britanics en Egipte. A mai d'aquelas accions, los vaissèls de guèrra italians èran pas supausats de far res de mai.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: E ara Japon. Japon èra un país insular, just coma Granda Bretanha.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Los sosmarins son de vaissèls concebuts per viatjar jos l'aiga, e i demòran pendent un periòde de temps prolongat.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Los sosmarins foguèron utilizats durant la Primièra Guèrra Mondiala e la Segonda Guèrra Mondiala. En aquel temps, èran fòrça lents e avián un camp de tir fòrça limitat.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Al començament de la guèrra viatjavan subretot sus la mar, mas estent que los radars comencèron a èsser desvolopats e a venir pus precises los sosmarins foguèron forçats a anar jos l’aiga per evitar d’èsser vistes.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Los sosmarins alemands èran sonats U-Boats. Los alemands èran fòrça bons per navegar e far foncionar lors sosmarins.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Pr'amor de lor reüssida amb los sosmarins, aprèp la guèrra s'es pas fisat als alemands de ne tenir fòrça.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: E òc! Lo rei Totankhamon, d’unes còps que i a denomenat "Rei Tot" or "L'enfant Rei", es un dels ancians reis egipcians mai coneguts a l’epòca contemporanèa.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: D'un biais interessant, èra pas considerat coma fòrça important dins los tempses ancians e foguèt pas inscrich sus la lista dels reis mai ancians.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Pasmens, la descobèrta de sa tomba en 1922 ne faguèt una celebritat. E mai se fòrça tombas del passat foguèron raubadas, aquesta tomba foguèt laissada virtualament pas trebolada.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: La màger part dels objèctes enterrats amb Totankhamon son estats plan preservats, comprenent los milièrs d'artefactes faches a partir de metals precioses e de pèiras raras.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: L'invencion de ròdas amb de rais faguèt los carris assirians mai leugièrs, mai rapids e melhor preparats per distanciar los soldats e los autres carris.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Las flèchas de sas balèstas mortalas podián penetrar l’armadura dels soldats rivals. A l’entorn de 1000 abC, los assirians introduguèron la primièra cavalariá.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Una cavalariá es una armada que combat sus de cavals. La sèla èra pas encara estada inventada, e doncas la cavalariá assiriana combatiá sus l'esquina nusa de lors cavals.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Coneissèm mantes politicians, scientifics, e artistas grècs. Possiblament la persona mai coneguda d’aquesta cultura es Omèr, lo legendari poèta òrb, que compausèt dos caps d’òbra de la literatura grèga: los poèmas l’Iliada e l’Odissèa.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofòcles e Aristofanes son encara de dramaturgs populars e sas pèças son consideradas coma demest las òbras mai grandas de la literatura mondiala.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Un autre grèc celèbre es un matematician Pitagòras, conegut mai que mai per son celèbre teorèma sus las relacions dels costats dels triangles d'angle drech.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: I a d'estimacions variablas sul nombre de locutors de l'indi. S'estima qu'es entre la segonda e la quatrena lenga mai comunament parlada dins lo mond entièr.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Lo nombre de locutors nadius vària en foncion de se los dialèctes que son pas estrechament ligats son comptats.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Las estimacions van de 340 milions a 500 milions de locutors, e fins a 800 milions de personas pòdon comprendre la lenga.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: L'indi e l'ordó son semblables dins lo vocabulari mas diferents dins l'escritura; dins las conversacions de la vida vidanta, los locutors de totas doas lengas pòdon abitualament se comprendre los uns e los autres.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: A l’entorn del sègle XV, lo nòrd d’Estònia foguèt jos una influéncia culturala granda d’Alemanha.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: D'unes monges alemands volián portar Dieu mai prèp del pòble autoctòn, alara inventèron la lenga literala estoniana.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Èra basat sus l'alfabet alemand e un caractèr "Õ/õ" foguèt apondut.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Long del temps, fòrça mots que foguèron manlevats a l’alemand fusionèron. Foguèt lo començament de las luses.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tradicionalament, l’eiretièr al tròn deviá anar dirèctament dins l‘armada tre qu’acabèsse l’escòla.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Pasmens, Charles anèt a l'universitat a Trinity College, a Cambridge, ont estudièt antropologia e arqueologia, puèi istòria, e obtenguèt un 2:2 (un diplòma mai bas de segonda classa).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles foguèt lo primièr membre de la Familha Reiala Britanica a recebre un diplòma.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: La Turquia europèa (Tràcia orientala o Romelia dins la peninsula dels Balcans) compren 3% del país.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Lo territòri de Turquia fa mai de 1 600 quilomètres (1 000 milas) de long e 800 km (500 milas) d’ample, amb una forma aproximativament rectangulara.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: L’espandi de Turquia, en comprenent los lacs, ocupa 783.562 quilomètres cairats (300.948 milas cairadas), dels quals 755.688 quilomètres cairats (291.773 milas cairadas) son dins l’Àsia del sud-oèst e 23.764 quilomètres cairats (9.174 milas cairadas) en Euròpa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: L’espandi de Turquia ne fa lo 37n país pus grand del mond, e es a l'entorn de la talha de la França metropolitana e del Reialme Unit combinats.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turquia es enrodada per de mars sus sos tres costats: la Mar Egèa a l’oèst, la Mar Negra al nòrd e la Mar Mediterranèa al sud.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxemborg a una istòria longa mas son independéncia data de 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Qualques parts actualas de Belgica èran de parts de Luxemborg dins lo passat mas venguèron bèlgas aprèp la revolucion bèlga de las annadas 1830.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxemborg a totjorn ensajat de demorar un país neutre mas es estat ocupat a l'encòp durant la Primièra Guèrra Mondiala e la Segonda Guèrra Mondiala per Alemanha.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: En 1957 Luxemborg venguèt un membre fondador de l'organizacion qu'es coneguda uèi coma l'Union Europèa.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: La Drukgyal Dzong es una fortalesa arroïnada e un monastèri bodista dins la part superiora del Districte de Paro (dins Phondey Village).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Se ditz qu’en 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel creèt aquesta fortalesa per commemorar sa victòria contra las fòrças tibetanas e mongòlas.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: En 1951, un incendi causèt que demorèssen sonque qualques relíquias del Drukgyal Dzong, coma l'imatge de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Aprèp l'incendi, la fortalesa foguèt preservada e protegida, per demorar una de las atraccions mai sensacionalas de Botan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Pendent lo sègle XVIII Cambòtja se trobèt quichada entre dos vesins potents, Tailàndia e Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Los tais envasiguèron Cambòtja mantes còps durant lo sègle XVIII e en 1772 destrusiguèron Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Dins las darrièras annadas del sègle XVIII los vietnamians envasiguèron tanben Cambòtja.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Dètz-e-uèch per cent dels veneçolans son al caumatge e la màger part dels que son emplegats trabalhan dins l’economia informala.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dos tèrces dels veneçolans que trabalhan o fan dins lo sector dels servicis, gaireben un quart trabalha dins l’industria e un cinquen trabalha dins l’agricultura.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Lo petròli es una industria importanta pels veneçolans, ont lo país es un exportador net, e mai se sonque un per cent de la populacion trabalha dins l’industria petrolièra.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Al començament de l'independéncia de la nacion, l'experiéncia dels jardins botanics de Singapor ajudèt a transformar l'isla en una vila jardin tropical.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: En 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, una orquidèa ibrida, foguèt causida coma flor nacionala de la nacion.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Cada an a l’entorn d’octobre gaireben 1,5 milion d’erbivòrs viatjan cap a las planas del sud, en traversant lo riu Mara, dempuèi los tucs del nòrd per las pluèjas.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: E puèi tornarmai cap al nòrd a travèrs de l'oèst, traversant un còp de mai lo riu Mara, aprèp las pluèjas a l’entorn del mes d’abril.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: La region de Serengeti conten lo Parc Nacional de Serengeti, la zòna de conservacion de Ngorongoro e la resèrva de caça de Maswa en Tanzania e la resèrva nacionala de Masai Mara a Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Aprendre a crear de mèdias interactius demanda de competéncias convencionalas e tradicionalas, e tanben d'aisinas mestrejadas dins los corses interactius (edicion de storyboards, de documents àudios e vidèos, contes, etc.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Lo design interactiu necessita que reavaloretz vòstras suposicions a prepaus de la produccion mediatica e d’aprendre a pensar d’un biais non-linear.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Lo design interactiu necessita que los compausants d’un projècte se connècten l’un a l’autre, mas a tanben de sens coma entitat separada.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Lo desavantatge dels zooms es que la complexitat focala e lo nombre d'elements d'objectius necessaris per aténher una gamma de longors focalas es plan mai grand qu'amb los objectius primièrs.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Es a venir mens un problèma estent que las manufacturas d’objectius atenhon d’estandards mai elevats dins lor produccion d’objectius.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Aquò a permés als zooms de donar de fotografias d’una qualitat comparabla a la que s’obten amb d’objectius de longor focala fixa.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Un autre inconvenient dels zooms es que l'obertura maximala (la velocitat) de l'objectiu es abitualament mai febla.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Aquò fa los zooms pas cars de mal utilizar dins de condicions de luminositat febla sens un flash.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un dels problèmas mai frequents quand s'ensaja de convertir un film al format DVD es la subreescanerizacion.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: La màger part de las televisions son fachas d'un biais que plai al public general.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Per aquesta rason, tot çò que vesètz a la tele aviá sas termièras copadas, en naut, en bas e suls costats.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Es fach per s’assegurar que l’imatge cobrís l'ecran entièr. Se ditz subrescanerizar.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Malastrosament, quand faretz un DVD, sos costats seràn plan probablament copats tanben, e se la vidèo aviá de sostítols tròp prèp del bas, seràn pas completament mostrats.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Lo castèl medieval tradicional a inspirat durant fòrça temps l’imaginacion, evocant d’imatges d’ajustas, de banquets e de cavalariá arturiana.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: E mai dempè al mitan de roïnas millenàrias, es aisit de remembrar los sons e las odors de las batalhas desaparegudas, de gaireben ausir lo batement de las batas sul pavat e de sentir la paur que monta de aes fòssas de les donjons.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Mas es nòstra imaginacion basada sus la realitat? Perqué foguèron bastits los castèls en primièr lòc? Cossí foguèron concebuts e bastits?
