eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Caracteristic d’aquel periòde, lo castèl Kirby Muxloe es mai un ostal fortificat qu’un castèl vertadièr.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Sas grandas fenèstras esmautadas e sas parets finas serián pas estadas capablas de resistir a una ataca determinada fòrça temps.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Dins las annadas 1480, quand sa construccion foguèt entamenada per Lord Hastings, lo país èra relativament pasible e sa defensa èra sonque necessària contra las còlas pichonas de rotièrs.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: L'equilibri dels poders èra un sistèma amb lo qual las nacions europèas ensagèron de mantenir la sobeiranetat nacionala de totes los estats europèus.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Lo concèpte èra que totas las nacions europèas devián cercar d'evitar qu'una nacion venguèsse potenta, e alavetz los govèrns nacionals cambiavan sovent lors alianças per tal de mantenir l'equilibri.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: La Guèrra de Succession espanhòla marquèt la primièra guèrra que son problematica centrala èra l’equilibri de poders.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Aquò marquèt un cambiament important, estant que las poténcias europèas aurián pas pus lo pretèxt d'èsser de guèrras religiosas. Alara, la Guèrra de Trenta Ans seriá la darrièra guèrra a èsser qualificada coma una guèrra religiosa.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Lo temple d'Artèmis a Efès foguèt destruch lo 21 de julh de 356 abC dins un acte de piroman comés per Erostrat.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Segon l’istòria, sa motivacion èra la fama a tot pèrdre. Los efesians, otratjats, anoncièron que lo nom d’Erostrat foguèsse pas jamai enregistrat.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: L'istorian grèc Estrabon notèt lo nom pus tard, qu'es aital que lo coneissèm uèi. Lo temple foguèt destruch la meteissa nuèch qu'Alexandre lo Grand nasquèt.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexandre, coma rei, prepausèt de pagar per reconstruire lo temple, mas son ofèrta foguèt rebutada. Mai tard, aprèp la mòrt d'Alexandre, lo temple foguèt reconstruch en 323 abC.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Asseguratz-vos que vòstra man es tan relaxada coma siá possible del temps que quichatz totas las nòtas corrèctament - ensajatz tanben de far pas de movements estranhs amb los dets.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Aital, vos cansaretz lo mens possible. Remembratz qu’es pas necite de quichar las claus amb granda fòrça per de volum suplementari coma sul piano.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Sus l'acordeon, per obtenir mai de volum, utilitzatz los bofets amb mai de pression o de velocitat.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Lo misticisme es lo perseguiment de la comunion amb, de l'identitat amb, o la consciéncia conscienta d'una realitat, divinitat, vertat esperitala ultima, o Dieu.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Lo cresent cerca una experiéncia dirècta, una intuicion o una vision de la realitat divina/de la divinitat o de las divinitats.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Los adèptas seguisson certanes biaisses de viure, o de practicas qu'an per tòca de noirir aquelas experiéncias.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Lo misticisme pòt èsser distinguit d'autras formas de cresenças e de devocion religiosa per son enfasi sus l'experiéncia persona dirècta d'un estat unic de consciéncia, particularament aqueles d'un caractèr pasible, perspicaç, aürós, o mai extasiat.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Lo sikhisme es una religion del soscontinent indian. Nasquèt dins la region de Punjab pendent lo sègle XV a partir d'una scission sectària dins la tradicion indó.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Los sikhs consideran que lor fe es una religion separada de l'indoïsme e mai se reconeisson sas rasics e tradicions indós.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Los sikhs designan lor religion coma gurmat, çò que significa en punjabi "lo camin del goró". Lo goró es un aspècte fondamental dins totas las religions indianas mas dins lo sikhisme a pres una importància que forma lo centre de las cresenças sikhs.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: La religion foguèt fondada pendent lo sègle XV per Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Seguiguèron en succession nòu autres gorós.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Pasmens, en junh de 1956, las promesas de Khroshchòv foguèron mesas a l'espròva quand de susmautas en Polonha, ont los trabalhadors manifestavan contra las penurias alimentàrias e las talhadas de salaris, se transformèron en una manifestacion generala contra lo comunisme.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: E mai se a la fin, Khroshchòv mandèt de tancs per restaurar l’òrdre, cediguèt a qualques demandas economicas e donèt son acòrd per nomenar lo popular Wladyslaw Gomulka coma novèl primièr ministre.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: La civilizacion de la val d'Indus èra una civilizacion de l'Edat del Bronze dins lo soscontinent indian del nòrd-oèst qu'englòba la màger part del Paquistan modèrn e qualques regions del nòrd-oèst d'Índia e del nòrd-èst d'Afganistan.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: La civilizacion floriguèt dins los bacins del flum Indus d'ont deriva son nom.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: E mai se qualques erudits especulan qu'estent que la civilizacion existiguèt tanben dins los bacins del flum Sarasvati ara assecat, deuriá èsser mai justament sonada la civilizacion Indus-Sarasvati, mentre que d’unes la denominan civilizacion harappan d'après Harappa, lo primièr dels sits que foguèt excavat durant las annadas 1920.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: La natura militarista de l'empèri roman ajudèt al desvolopament d'avançadas medicalas.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: De mètges comencèron a èsser recrutats per l'Emperador August e mai formèron lo primièr còs medical roman per emplec aprèp la fin de las batalhas.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Los cirurgians coneissián divèrses sedatius que comprenon la morfina facha d'extractes de granas de pavòt e l'escopolamina de las granas de jusquiam.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Venguèron eficaces per las amputacions per tal de salvar los pacients de la gangrena e tanben en torniquets e pinças arterialas per restancar lo flux sanguin.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Long de multiples sègles, l'empèri roman portèt a de grandas avançadas dins lo domeni de la medecina e fomèt una bèla part de las coneissenças qu'avèm uèi.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: L'origami Pureland es un origami amb la restriccion qu'un sol plec pòt èsser fach al meteis temps, los plecs mai complèxes coma los plecs inversats son pas autorizats e totes los plecs an d'emplaçaments simples.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Foguèt desvolopat per John Smith dins las annadas 1970 per ajudar los plegaires inexperimentats o los qu'an de capacitat motrises limitadas.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Los enfants desvolopan una consciéncia de raça e los estereotips racials pro joves e aqueles estereotips racials afèctan lo comportament.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Per exemple, los enfants que s’identifican a una minoritat raciala qu’es estereotipada coma trabalhant pas a l'escòla tendon a pas trabalhar plan a l’escòla tre que son assabentats de l’estereotip associat amb lor raça.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace es lo tresen sit web mai popular utilizat als Estats Units e ten 54 milions de perfils actualament.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Aqueste sits web an obtengut fòrça atencion, especialament dins lo domeni de l'educacion.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Existisson d'aspèctes positius a aqueles sits webs, los quals comprenon, èsser capable de configurar facilament una pagina de classa que pòt inclure de blògs, de vidèos, de fòtos e d'autras foncions.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Se pòt accedir aisidament a aquela pagina en fornir pas qu’una adreça web, çò que fa qu’es de bon remembrar e aisit de picar per d’estudiants que pòdon aver de problèmas en utilizar lo clavièr o amb l’ortografia.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Pòt èsser personalizat per o far mai aisit de legir e tanben amb mai o mens de color coma o desiratz.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Lo Desòrdre de Deficit d'Atencion "es un sindròme neurologic que sa triada de definicions classicas de simptòmas compren l'impulsivitat, la distractibilitat, e l’iperactivitat o una energia excessiva".
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Es pas un andicap de l’aprendissatge, es un desòrdre de l'aprendissatge; "afècta de 3 a 5 del cent de totes los enfants, benlèu tant coma 2 milions d’enfants americans".
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Los enfants qu'an de problèmas de deficit d'atencion an de dificultats bèlas per se concentrar sus de causas coma lo trabalh escolar, mas se pòdon concentrar sus de causas que lor agrada de far coma jogar a de jòcs o agachar sos dessenhs animats preferits o escriure de frasas sens pontuacion.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Aquestes enfants tendon a aver fòrça problèmas, perque "an de comportaments a risca, cercan de bregas e desfison l'autoritat" per tal d'estimular son cervèl, estant que son cervèl pòt pas èsser estimulat amb de metòdes normals.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: L’ADD afècta las relacions amb d'autres collègas perque los autres enfants pòdon pas comprendre perqué agisson del biais que fan o perqué letrejan del biais qu'o fan o que lor nivèl de maturitat es diferent.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Coma la capacitat d'obtenir la coneissença e d’aprendre a cambiat d’un tal biais coma es estat mencionat abans lo ritme de basa amb lo que la coneissença èra obtenguda cambièt.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: L'apròchi per obtenir d'informacions èra diferent. La pression residissiá pas pus dins lo remembre individual, mas la capacitat de remembrar lo tèxt venguèt mai una preocupacion.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: En esséncia, la Renaissença faguèt un cambiament significatiu dins l'apròchi de l'aprendissatge e la disseminacion del saber.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: A diferéncia dels autres primats, los ominids utilizan pas mai lors mans per la locomocion o per equilibrar lor pes o se balancejar pels arbres.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: La man e lo pè del chimpanzé son semblables en talha e longo, çò que reflectís l'utilizacion de la man per portar de pes dins lo caminar sus las articulacions.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: La man umana es mai corta que lo pè, amb d'onças mai drechas.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: De fossils d'òsses d'una man vièlhs de dos milions a tres milions d’ans revèlan aqueste desviament en especializacion de la man dempuèi la locomocion cap a la manipulacion.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Qualques personas creson que far l'experiéncia de mantes sòmis lucids induches artificialament pro sovent pòt representar una granda lassièra.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: La rason principala d'aqueste fenomèn es la resulta dels sòmis lucids qu'espandisson la longor del temps entre los estats REM.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Amb mens de REMs per nuèch, aqueste estat dins lo qual vivètz un sòm real e vòstre còrs recupèra ven pro infrequent per venir un problèma.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Es just tan fatigant coma s’èretz a vos desvelhar cada vint o trenta minutas e agachar la tele.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: L'efièch es dependent de la frequéncia de vòstre cervèl per temptar de somiar lucidament cada nuèch.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Las causas foncionèron pas coma cal pels italians en Africa del nòrd gaireben tre la debuta. A una setmana de la declaracion de guèrra d’Itàlia lo 10 de junh de 1940, los 11th Hussars britanics avián sasit Fort Capuzzo en Libia.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Dins una emboscada a l'èst de Bardia, los britanics capturèron l'engenhaire en cap de la desena armada italiana, lo General Lastucci.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Lo 28 de junh, lo marescal Italo Balbo, lo governador general de Libia e aparent eiretièr de Mussolini, foguèt tuat per de fòc amic del temps qu'aterrava a Tobrok.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: L'espòrt modèrn de l'escrima es jogat a mantes nivèls, dempuèi los estudiants que l'aprenon a l'universitat fins a de competicions professionalas e olimpicas.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: L'espòrt es principalament jogat en format de dual, un escrimaire contra un autre.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Lo gòlf es un jòc que los jogaires i utilizan de clubs per lançar de balas dins de traucs.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Dètz-e-uèch traucs son jogats pendent una ronde regulara, amb de jogaires que començan abitualament pel primièr trauc del percors e en acabant pel dètz-e-ochen.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Lo jogaire que fa lo mens de còps o de balançaments del club per terminar lo percors ganha.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Lo jòc se jòga sus l'èrba, e l'èrba a l'entorn del trauc es tonduda pus cortament e es sonada lo green.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Benlèu lo tipe de torisme mai frequent es çò que la màger part de las gents assòcian amb los viatges: lo torisme recreatiu.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Aquò es quand las gents van a un endrech qu’es plan diferent de lor vida rotinièra de cada jorn per se relaxar e se divertir.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Las plajas, los parcs tematics e los campings son sovent los endreches mai comunament frequentats pels toristas que se vòlon divertir.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Se l’objectiu de la visita d’un endrech particular es de conéisser son istòria e sa cultura, aquesta mena de torisme es sonada torisme cultural.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Se pòt que los toristas visiten los divèrses monuments principals d’un país en particular o pòdon simplament optar de se centrar sonque sus una zòna.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Los colons, en vesent aquela activitat, avián tanben demandat de renfòrces.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Las tropas de renfòrç de las posicions avançadas comprenián los 1èr e 3n regiments de New Hampshire de 200 òmes, jos la direccion dels colonèls John Stark e James Reed (venguèron totes dos generals aprèp).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Los òmes de Stark prenguèron de posicions long de la barranha a la poncha nòrd de la posicion dels colons.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Quand la marèa bassa obriguèt un vuèg long de la Mystic River long del nòrd-èst de la peninsula, espandiguèron rapidament la barranha amb un muret de pèira cort al nòrd que s'acabava a la poncha de l'aiga sus una plaja pichona.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley o Stark placèron una marca a mai o mens 100 pès (30 m) en fàcia de la barricada e ordenèron que degun tirèsse pas fins que l'armada regulara la passèsse.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Lo plan american se basava sul lançament d'atacas coordinadas dempuèi tres direccions diferentas.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Lo general John Cadwalder lancèt una ataca de diversion contra la garnison britanica a Bordentown, pr’amor de blocar tota possibilitat de renfòrces.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Lo general James Ewing portèt 700 milicians a travèrs del riu a Trenton Ferry, s'apoderèt del pont sus Assunpink Creek e evitèt que las tropas enemigas s’escapèssen.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: La principala fòrça d'assaut de 2 400 òmes traversariá lo riu a nòu milas al nòrd de Trenton e puèi se devesiriá en dos grops, un jos Greene e un jos Sullivan, per tal de lançar una ataca abans l'alba.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Amb lo cambiament de corsa del quart a la mièja mila, la velocitat ven d’una importància mendra e l’endurança ven una necessitat absoluda.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: De segur, un corredor de mièg fons de primièr òrdre, un òme que pòt batre las doas minutas, deu tenir una bona dòsi de velocitat, mas l'endurança deu èsser cultivada a tot prètz.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Quelques corsas de cross-country pendent l'ivèrn, combinadas a d'exercicis de musculacion per la part superiora del còs, son la melhora preparacion per la sason de corsa.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: De bonas practicas nutricionalas soletas pòdon pas generar de performanças d'elita, mas pòdon afectar significativament lo benésser general dels joves atlètas.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Mantenir un equilibri salutari d'energia, en metre en practica d'abituds d'idratacion eficaças, tot en comprendre los divèrses aspèctes de practicas de suplementacion pòt ajudar los atlètas a melhorar lors performàncias e aumentar lor plaser de l'espòrt.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: La corsa de mièg fons es un espòrt relativament pauc costós; pasmens i a fòrça idèas faussas per çò qu'es de qualques parts d'equipament que fan mestièr per participar.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Los produches pòdon èsser crompats com fan mestièr, mas una màger part aurà pas gaire o pas cap d’impacte real sus la performància.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Los atlètas pòdon sentir que preferisson un produch e mai quand fornís pas cap de benefici vertadièr.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: L'atòm pòt èsser considerat coma un dels elements fondamentalas de tota la matèria.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Es una entitat plan complèxa que consistís, segon un modèl de Bohr simplificat, en un nuclèu central orbitat per d’electrons, un pauc semblanta a las planetas qu'orbitan a l'entorn del Solelh - veire Figura 1.1.
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Lo nuclèu consistís de doas particulas - de neutrons e de protons.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Los protons an una carga positiva electrica mentre que los neutrons an pas cap de carga. Los electrons an una carga electrica negativa.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Per verificar l’estat de la victima, vos cal d’en primièr agachar amb atencion lo lòc per garantir vòstra seguretat.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Vos cal remarcar la posicion de la victima quand vos sarratz d’el o d’ela e tot signe automatic d’alèrta.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Se vos fasètz mal en ensajar d'ajudar, es possible qu'aquò crèe una situacion encara pièger.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: L'estudi trobèt que la depression, la paur e lo catastrofisme a mediatizat la relacion entre la dolor e l'andicap per las personas que patisson de lombalgia.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Sonque los efièches del catastrofisme, e non pas la depression e la paur, èran condicionals de las sessions setmanièras estructuradas e regularas d'AP.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Los que participan a d’activitats regularas aguèron de mestièr de mai de sosten en tèrmes de percepcion negativa de dolor en distinguissent las diferéncias de dolor cronica e de sentiment d'incomoditat del movement fisic normal.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: La vision, o la capacitat de veire depend dels organs sensorials del sistèma visual o uèlhs.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: I a mantas construccions diferentas d'uèlhs, amb una gamma de complexitat en foncion de las necessitats de l'organisme.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Las construccions diferentas an de capacitats diferentas, son sensiblas a de longors d'onda diferentas e an de gras diferents d'acuitat, demandan tanben un tractament diferent per donar de sens a l'intrada e de nombres diferents per foncionar d'un biais optimal.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Una populacion es la soma dels organismes d’una espécia particulara dins un airal geografic donat.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Quand totes los individus d’una populacion son identics en çò que concernís un trach fenotipic particular son coneguts coma essent monomorfics.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Quand los individus mòstran divèrsas variantas d’un trach particular son polimorfics.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Las colonias de formigas legionàrias fan de marchas e nison dins de fasas diferentas tanben.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Pendent lor fasa nomadica, las formigas legionàrias marchan de nuèch e s’arrèstan per campar durant la jornada.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: La colonia comença una fasa nomadica quand los aliments disponibles avián mermat. Pendent aquela fasa, la colonia fa de nises temporaris que son cambiats cada jorn.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Cadun d’aquestes pilhatges o marchas nomadas dura aproximativament 17 jorns.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Qué es una cellula? Lo mot cellula ven del mot latin "cella", que significa "cambra pichona", e foguèt inventat per primièr còp per un microscopista qu'observava l'estructura del siure.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: La cellula es l'unitat basica de totas las causas vivas, e totes los organismes son compausats d'una cellula o mai.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Las cellulas son talament basicas e essencialas dins l'estudi de la vida, de fach, que son sovent denominadas "los elements constitutius de la vida".
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Lo sistèma nerviós manten l'omeostasi en mandar d'impulsions nerviosas a travèrs del còs per gardar lo flux del sang en foncionament coma se i aguèsse pas de perturbacions.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Aquestas impulsions nerviosas pòdon èsser enviadas tan rapidament dins tot lo còrs çò que garda lo còrs en seguretat de tota menaça potenciala.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Las tornadas revoluman un airal pichon comparat a las autras tempèstas violentas, mas pòdon destruire tot sus son camin.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Las tornadas arrancan los arbres, esquiçan de placas dels bastiments e escampan las veituras amondaut dins lo cèl. Dos per cent de las tornadas mai violentas duran mai de tres oras.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Aquestas tempèstas monstruosas an de vents que van fins a 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Los umans son estats a fabricar e utilizar de lentilhas pel grossiment dempuèi de milièrs e de milierats d'annadas.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Pasmens, los primièrs telescòpis vertadièrs foguèron faches en Euròpa a la fin del sègle XVI.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Aquestes telescòpis utilizèron una combinason de doas lentilhas per far que los objèctes distants apareguèssen a l'encòp mai pròches e mai grands.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: La cupiditat e l’egoïsme seràn totjorn demest nosautres e es la natura de la cooperacion que se la majoritat ne tira de beneficis i aurà totjorn mai a ganhar sul cort tèrme en agissent egoïstament.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Amb d'astre, la màger part de las gents realizaràn que l'opcion melhora a long tèrme per eles es de trabalhar amassa amb los autres.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Maitas personas sòmian al jorn que los umans podràn viatjar a una autra estela e explorar d'autres monds, qualques personas se demandan çò que i a lai e d'unes creson que d'extraterrèstres o una autra forma de vida pòt viure sus una autra planeta.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Mas, s'aquò se debana vertadièrament es probable que se debanarà pas pendent fòrça temps. Las estelas son talament alunhadas que i de trilions de milas entre las estelas que son de "vesinas".
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Benlèu un jorn, vòstres rèirefelens se tendràn a la cima d'un mond extraterrèstre en se pausar de questions sus sos ancians aujòls.
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Los animals son faches de fòrça cellulas. Manjan de causas e las digerisson a l'interior. La màger part dels animals se pòt mòure.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Sonque los animals an de cervèls (e mai se pas totes los animals n'an; las medusas, per exemple, an pas cap de cervèl).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Los animals se tròban de pertot sus Tèrra. Cavan dins lo sòl, nadan dins los oceans, e vòlan dins lo cèl.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Una cellula es l’unitat estructurala e foncionala mai petita d’un organisme (causas) vivent.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Cellula ven del mot latin cella que significa cambra pichona.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: S'agachatz de causas vivas jos un microscòpi, veiretz que son fachas de pichons cairats o de bolas.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, un biologista anglés, vegèt de cairats pichonets dins lo siure amb un microscòpi.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Semblavan de cambras. Èra la primièra persona a observar de cellulas mòrtas.
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Los elements e los compausats se pòdon desplaçar d'un estat a un autre e cambiar pas.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: L'azòt coma gas a las meteissas proprietats que l'azòt liquid. L'estat liquid es pus dens mas las moleculas son encara las meteissas.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: L’aiga n’es un autre exemple. Lo compausat qu'es l'aiga es compausada de dos atòms d’idrogèn e d’un atòm d’oxigèn.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: A la meteissa estrucura moleculara que siá un gas, un liquid o un solid.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: E mai se son estat fisic pòt cambiar, son estat quimic demòra lo meteis.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Lo temps es quicòm qu’es tot a l’entorn de nosautres, e afècta tot çò que fasèm, çaquelà es de mal comprendre.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Lo temps es estat estudiat per d’erudits religioses, filosofics, e scientifics durant de milierats d’annadas.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Vivèm lo temps coma una tièra d’eveniments que passan del futur a travèrs del present al passat.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Lo temps es tanben cossí comparam la durada (longor) dels eveniments.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Podètz marcar lo passatge del temps solet en observar la repeticion d’un eveniment ciclic. Un eveniment ciclic es quicòm que se debana encara e encara regularament.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Uèi, los ordenadors son utilizats per manipular d'imatges e de vidèos.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: D'animacions sofisticadas pòdon èsser construchas sus d'ordenadors, e aqueste genre d'animacion es cada còp mai utilizat a la television e dins los films.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: La musica es sovent enregistrada en far servir d'ordenadors sofisticats per tractar e mesclar los sons amassa.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Fòrça temps pendent los sègles XIX e XX, se creguèt que los primièrs abitants de Nòva Zelanda èran los maòris, que caçavan d’aucèls gigants sonats moas.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: La teoria creèt alara l’idèa que los maòris migrèron dempuèi Polinesia dins una granda flòta e prenguèron Nòva Zelanda als moriòris, instaurant una societat agricòla.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Pasmens, de pròvas novèlas suggerisson que los moriòris èran un grop de maòris del continent qu'aviá migrat dempuèi Nòva Zelanda a las Islas Chatham, desvolopant lor pròpria cultura distintiva e pacifica.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: I aviá tanben una autra tribú sus las islas Chatham, èran de maòris qu'avián emigrat de Nòva Zelanda.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Se sonavan eles meteisses los moriòris i aguèt qualques escaramossas, e a la fin, los moriòris foguèron anequelits.
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: De personas qu’èran estadas implicadas pendent divèrsas decennias nos ajudèron a apreciar nòstras fòrças e passions en avalorar a l'encòp francament las dificultats e mai los fracasses.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Del temps qu’escotam d’individus partejar lor istòria individuala, familiala e organizacionala, avèm aquesit d’informacions preciosas del passat e d’unas de las personalitats que influencièron d‘un biais bon o marrit la cultura de l’organizacion.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Encara que comprendre sa pròpria istòria supause pas la compreneson de la cultura, ajuda almens vertadièrament las gents a aquesir lo sens d’ont an sa plaça a l’interior de l’istòria de l’organizacion.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Del temps qu'avaloran sos succèsses e en se far conscient dels fracasses, los individus e la totalitat de las personas que participan descobrisson mai prigondament las valors, la mission, e las fòrças motrises de l’organization.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Dins aqueste cas, remembrar d'exemples anteriors de comportament d'entrepreneire e los succèsses que ne resultèron ajudèt las personas a èsser obèrtas als cambiaments novèls e a las novèlas direccions per la glèisa locala.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: De talas istòrias de reüssida atenuèron las paurs del cambiament, mentre que creavan d'inclinacions positivas cap al cambiament dins lo futur.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Los modèls de pensada convergenta son de tecnicas per resòlvre de problèmas qu'unisson d'idèas o de domenis diferents per trobar una solucion.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: L'objectiu d’aqueste estat d'esperit es la velocitat, la logica e la precision, e tanben l'identificacion dels faches, la reaplicacion de tecnicas existentas, la collècta d’informacion.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Lo factor pus important d'aqueste estat d'esperit es: i a sonque una responsa corrècta. Pensatz pas qu'a doas responsas, es a dire corrècte o fals.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Aqueste tipe de pensada es associat amb una cèrta sciéncia o de procediments estandards.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Las gents qu'an aqueste tipe de pensada an una pensada logica, son capables de memorizar de modèls, de resòlvre de problèmas, e de trabalhar sus de test scientifics.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Los umans son de luènh l'espècia qu'a mai de talent per legir las pensadas dels autres.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Aquò significa que sèm capables de predire amb succès çò que d'autres umans percebon, vòlon far, creson, sabon o desiran.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Demest aquelas capacitats, la de comprendre l’intencion dels autres es cruciala. Nos permet de resòlvre las ambigüitats possiblas de las accions fisicas.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Per exemple, se foguèssetz a veire qualqu’un que peta un veire de veitura, imaginariatz probablament qu'ensajava de raubar la veitura d’un stranger.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Auriá mestièr d'èsser jutjat diferentament s'aviá perdut las claus de la veitura e qu'èra dins sa pròpria veitura qu'ensajava de dintrar per fòrça.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI es basat sus un fenomèn de fisica sonat resonància magnetica nuclear (RMN), que foguèt descobèrta dins las annadas 1930 per Felix Bloch (que trabalhava a l'Universitat Stanford) e Edward Purcell (de l'Universitat Harvard).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Dins aquesta resonància, lo camp magnetic e las ondas de ràdio causan l'emission de senhals de ràdio minusculs dels atòms.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Dins l’annada 1970, Raymond Damadian, un mètge e cercaire, descobriguèt las basas d'utilizacion de l’imatjariá de resonància magnetica coma una aisina pel diagnostic medical.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Quatre ans mai tard un brevet foguèt acordat, lo qual foguèt lo primièr brevet mondial liurat dins lo domeni de MRI.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: En 1977, lo Dr. Damadian terminèt la construccion del primièr escanèr IRM “de còrs entièr”, que bategèt l'”Indomdable”.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: La comunicacion asincròna encoratja a prendre de temps per la refleccion e la reaccion cap als autres.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Permet als estudiants de trabalhar a son pròpri ritme e de contrarotlar lo ritme de l’informacion pedagogica.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: A mai, i a fòrça mens restriccions de temps amb la possibilitat d'aver d'oraris de trabalh flexibles. (Bremer, 1998)
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: L’utilizacion d’Internet e lo World Wide Web permeton als aprenents d’aver accès a l’informacion de contunh.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Los estudiants tanben pòdon sometre de questions als instructors a tot moment de la jornada e esperar de responsas relativament rapidas, puslèu que d'esperar la reünion presenciala seguenta.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: L'apròchi pòstmodèrn de l'aprendissatge ofrís la libertat dels absoluts. I a pas una bona manièra unica d'aprendre.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: De fach, i a pas de bonas o marridas causas a aprendre. L'aprendissatge se debana dins l’experiéncia entre l’aprenent e la coneissença presentada.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Nòstra experiéncia actuala amb totes los programas de television basats sus l'aprendissatge de presentacion de l'informacion e de bricolatge, illustra aqueste ponch.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Sèm tan nombroses a agachar un programa de television que nos informa d'un procès o d'una experiéncia que i participarem pas jamai o que n'aplicarem pas jamai aquelas coneissenças.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Anam pas jamai far la revision d'una veitura, construire una font dins nòstre cort, viatjar a Peró per examinar de roïnas ancianas, o remodelar l‘ostal de nòstre vesin.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Gràcias a las ligasons per cables de fibra optica sosmarina cap a Euròpa e per satellit de larga benda, Groenlàndia es ben connectada amb 93% de sa populacion qu'a accès a Internet.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Vòstra ostalariá o vòstres òstes (se demoratz dins una pension o un ostal privat) auràn probablament la wifi o un PC connectat a Internet, e totes los vilatges an un cafè Internet o qualques endreches amb de wifi publica.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Coma es estat mencionat abans, encara que lo mot "esquimaud" demòre acceptable als Estats Units, es considerat coma pejoratiu per fòrça pòbles artics que son pas americans, particularament a Canadà.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: E mai se podètz ausir aqueste mot utilizat pels autoctòns de Groenlàndia, son emplec deuriá èsser evitat pels estrangièrs.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Los abitants autoctòns de Groenlàndia s'apèlan eles meteisses inuits a Canadà e kalaalleq (plural kalaallit), un groenlandés, en Groenlàndia.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: La delinquéncia, e los marrits comportaments cap als estrangièrs en general, es virtualament desconeguda en Groenlàndia. E mai dins las vilas, i a pas de "zòna dificila."
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Lo temps freg es bensai lo sol perilh vertadièr al que faràn fàcia los que son pas preparats.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Se visitatz Groenlàndia pendent las sasons frejas (en tot considerar que d'ont mai anatz al nòrd, d'ont mai freg farà), es essencial de portar de vestits pro cauds.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Los jorns fòrça longs durant l’estiu pòdon portar de problèmas per aver pro de sòm e d’unes problèmas de santat associats.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Durant l’estiu, mesfisatz-vos tanben dels moissals nordics. E mai se transmeton pas cap de malautiá, pòdon èsser irritants.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: E mai se l’economia de San Francisco es ligada al fach qu’es una atraccion toristica de classa mondiala, son economia es diversificada.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Los sectors d'emplec mai grands son los servicis professionals, lo govèrn, la finança, lo comèrci e lo torisme.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Sa representacion frequenta dins la musica, los films, la literatura e la cultura populara a ajudat a rendre famosa la vila e sos endreches simbolics principals dins lo mond entièr.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco a desvolopat una infrastructura toristica importanta amb de nombroses otèls, restaurants, e d'installacions pels congrèsses de primièr òrdre.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco es tanben un dels melhors endreches de la nacion per d'autras cosinas asiaticas: coreana, tai, indiana, e japonesa.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Viatjar a Walt Disney World representa un pelegrinatge màger per fòrça familhas americanas.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: La visita "tipica" implica de volar fins a l’aeropòrt internacional d’Orlando, èsser portat en bus a un otèl Disney dins lo parc, passar a l’entorn d’una setmana sens sortir de las proprietats de Disney, e tornar a l’ostal.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: I a de variacions infinidas possiblas, mas aquò demòra çò que la màger part de las gents vòlon dire quand parlan d""anar a Disney World".
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Fòrça bilhetas vendudas en linha a travèrs de sits web d'encants coma eBay o Craigslist son de bilhetas park-hopper de multiples jorns parcialament utilizadas.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: E mai s’es una activitat fòrça comuna, es enebida per Disney: los bilhets son non-transferibles.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Tot campatge en jos de la poncha del Grand Canyon necessita un permés pel rèirepaís.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Los permeses son limitats per protegir lo canyon, e venon disponibles tre lo 1èr jorn del mes, quatre meses abans lo mes de començament.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: E doncas, un permés de visita del rèirepaís per las datas que comencen en mai ven disponible a partir del 1èr de genièr.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: L'espaci per las zònas pus popularas, coma lo Bright Angel Campground qu'es adjacent al Phantom Ranch, s'emplena generalament per las demandas recebudas tre la primièra data que son obèrtas a las reservacions.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: I a un nombre limitat de permeses reservats per las demandas sens rendetz-vos disponibles segon l'òrdre d'arribada.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Penetrar dins lo sud d'Africa en veitura es un biais fantastic de contemplar tota la beutat de la region e tanben d'anar a d'endreches en defòra dels itineraris toristics normals.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Aquò se pòt far amb una veitura normala en prevesent amb atencion mas un 4x4 es fòrtament conselhat e fòrça endreches son solament accessible amb un 4x4 de ròdas grandas.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Gardatz a l'esperit mentre sètz a far vòstres plans qu'encara que lo sud d'Africa siá estable totes los païses vesins o son pas.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Las exigéncias de visa e los prèses vàrian d’una nacion a l’autra e son afectats pel país d’ont venètz.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Cada país a tanben sas leis unicas qu'exigisson quines objèctes d'urgéncia se devon trobar dins la veitura.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls es una vila dins la porcion occidentala de Zimbabwe, de l'autre costat de la frontièra amb Livingstone, Zambia, e pròcha de Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: La vila se tròba immediatament pròcha de las cascadas, e ne son l’atraccion màger, mas aquesta destinacion toristica populara prepausa a l’encòp als que cercan l’aventura e als que vòlon veire de païsatges un fum d’oportunitats per un sojorn mai long.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Pendent la sason de las pluèjas (de novembre a març), lo volum d’aiga serà mai elevat e las Cascadas seràn mai impressionantas.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Sètz segurs d’èsser trempats se traversatz lo pont o se caminatz long dels camins sinuoses al costat de las Cascadas.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: D'un autre costat, es precisament perque lo volum d'aiga es talament naut que vòstra vision de las Cascadas vertadièras serà escuresida—per tota l'aiga!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: La tomba de Totankhamon (KV62). KV62 pòt èsser la mai famosa de las tombas de la Val, lo lòc de la descobèrta en 1922 d’Howard Carter del lòc d'enterrament reial gaireben intacte del jove rei.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Comparada a la màger part de las autras tombas reialas, pasmens, la tomba de Totankhamon val tot bèl just la pena d'èsser visitada, estant qu'es fòrça mai petita e a una decoracion limitada.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Totes los que son interessats per veire de pròvas dels damatges de la momia faches durant las temptativas de la traire del taüt seràn decebuts que sonque lo cap e las espatlas son visibles.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Las riquesas fabulosas de la tomba son pas pus a l'interior, mas son estadas transportadas al Musèu Egipcian del Caire.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Los visitaires qu’an un temps limitat deurián puslèu passar son temps endacòm mai.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, a 12 km al sud-oèst de Siemp Reap. Aqueste temple en cima del tuc foguèt bastit a la fin del sègle IX, durant lo regne del Rei Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: L’atmosfèra grisa del temple e la vista sul lac Tonle Sap fan que l'ascension cap al tuc valga la pena.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Una visita al sit pòt èsser comòdament combinada amb una passejada en barca sul lac.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: L'Angkor Pass fa mestièr per intrar dins lo temple, e doncas vos cal pas oblidar de portar vòstre passapòrt quand vos dirigissètz a Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalèm es la capitala e la vila mai granda d'Israèl, e mai se la màger part dels autres païses e las Nacions Unidas la reconeisson pas coma la capitala d'Israèl.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: La vila anciana suls tucs de Judèa a una istòria fascinanta que s'estend sus de milièrs d'annadas.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: La vila es sagrada per las tres religions monoteïstas - Lo judaïsme, lo cristianisme e l'islam, e servís de centre esperital, religiós e cultural.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Per encausa de la significacion religiosa de la vila, e en particular los sits nombroses de la zòna de la Vièlha Vila, Jerusalèm es una de las destinacions toristicas principalas d'Israèl.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalèm a fòrça sits istorics, arqueologics e culturals, amb de centres comercials vibrants e plens de gents, de bars e de restaurants.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Eqüator demanda que los ciutadans cubans receben una letra d’invitacion abans d’intrar en Eqüator a travèrs d’aeropòrts internacionals o de ponches d’admission frontalièrs.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Aquela letra deu èsser autentificada pel Ministèri Eqüatorian d’Afars Estrangièrs, e se conformar a cèrtas exigéncias.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Aquestas exigéncias an per tòca de fornir un flux migratòri organizat entre totes dos païses.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Los ciutadans cubans que son detentors de cartas verdas americanas deurián visitar un consulat eqüatorian per obtenir una exempcion d'aquesta condicion.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Vòstre passapòrt deu èsser valid durant almens 6 meses mai enlà de vòstras datas de viatge. Un bilhet de viatge anar e tornar/de correspondéncia es necessari per provar la durada de vòstre sojorn.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Las visitas guidadas son mens caras pels grops mai grands, alara se sètz solet o just amb un amic, ensajatz d’encontrar d’autras personas per formar una còla de quatre a sièis personas e arribar a un melhor prètz per persona.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Pasmens, deuriá pas èsser vertadièrament en defòra de vòstra preocupacion, perque los toristas son sovent barrejats per emplenar las veituras.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Sembla en realitat d'èsser mai un biais d’enganar las personas per creire que devon pagar mai.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Impausanta sus la cima septentrionala de Machu Picchu se tròba aquela montanha esquiva, sovent tela de fons de mantas fòtos de las roïnas.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Sembla un pauc intimidant vist d'en bas, e es una ascension esquiva e dificila, mas la màger part de las personas en forma deurián èsser capablas de la realizar en aperaquí 45 minutas.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: De grasas de pèira son pausadas long de la màger part del camin e, dins las seccions mai esquivas, de cables d'acièr fornisson una baranda de sosten.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Aquò dich, esperatz a demorar sens alen, e vos cal far atencion dins las porcions pus esquivas, subretot quand son trempas, estent que pòt venir perilhós rapidament.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: I a una cauna minuscula prèp de la cima que se deu traversar, es fòrça bassa e i sètz fòrça quichat.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Veire los sits e la fauna de las Galápagos se fa melhor dins una embarcacion coma o faguèt Darwin en 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Mai de 60 vaissèls de crosièra crosan las aigas de las Galápagos - e an una talha que va de 8 a 100 passatgièrs.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: La màger part de las gents resèrvan sas plaças plan en avança (que los batèus son abitualament plens pendent la sason nauta).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Asseguratz-vos que l’agent al prèp de qui reservatz es un especialista de las Galapagos e qu'a una bona coneissença d'una granda varietat d'embarcacions.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Aquò assolidarà que vòstres interèsses particulars e/o constrenchas son compatibles amb lo batèu que lor conven mai.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Abans que los espanhòls arribèssen durant lo sègle XVI, lo nòrd de Chile èra jos dominacion inca mentre que los araucans indigèns (los mapuches) abitavan lo centre e lo sud de Chile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Los mapuches èran tanben un dels darrièrs grops indigènas independents d'America que foguèssen pas completament absorbits per la dominacion ispanofòna fins aprèp l'independéncia de Chile.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: E mai se Chile declarèt son independéncia en 1810 (al mièg de las guèrras napoleonianas que laissèron Espanha sens un govèrn central foncional durant un parelh d'annadas), la victòria decisiva suls espanhòls foguèt pas realizada fins a 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: La Republica Dominicana (en espanhòl: República Dominicana) es un país carib qu'ocupa la part orientala de la mitat d'Hispaniola, que parteja amb Haiti
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Al costat de las plajas de sabla blanca e los païsatges montanhoses, lo país ten la vila europèa mai anciana de las Americas, qu’es ara una part de Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: L'isla foguèt abitada primièr pels taínos e los caribs. Los caribs èran un pòble que parlava arawakan e qu'arribèt a l'entorn de 10.000 abC.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Brèvament aprèp las qualques annadas que seguiguèron l’arribada d’exploradors europèus, la populacion dels tainos foguèt reducha significativament pels conquistadors espanhòls.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Basat sus las estimacions de Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) entre 1492 e 1498 los conquistadors espanhòls tuèron aperaquí 100.000 taínos.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Aqueste espaci es estat bastit coma l'atri per un convent del sègle XVII, del que lo Templo de San Diego es lo solet bastiment qu'aja subreviscut.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Fonciona ara coma la plaça centrala, e a de longa un fum de causas que s’i passan, jorn e nuèch.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: I a un bon nombre de restaurants qu'enròdan lo jardin e, pendent las tantossadas e los vèspres, i a de concèrts gratuïts sovent donats dempuèi la miranda centrala.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejón del Besos (alèia del poton). Dos balcons separats per sonque 69 centimètres es lo centre d'una vièlha legenda d'amor.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Per qualques centims qualques enfants vos ne contaràn l’istòria.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island es un viatge d'un jorn popular o d'excursion de dimenjada que prepausa de caiac, de caminadas, de botigas, de restaurants, e mai encara.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Aquesta comunitat autentica es situada a Howe Sound còsta Vancouver, e es d'accès aisit per mejan de taxis maritims que sortisson de Granville Island dins lo centre de Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Per aqueles que lor agrada de far d'activitats exterioras, una excursion fins al corridor Mar a Cèl es essenciala.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (a 1,5 ora en veitura de Vancouver) es car mas plan conegut per encausa dels Jòcs Olimpics d’Ivèrn de 2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: En ivèrn, profechatz d'unas de las melhoras pistas d'esquí d’America del Nòrd e, durant l’estiu ensajatz qualques passejadas en BTT autenticas.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Cal reservar los permeses en avança. Devètz aver un permés per passar la nuèch a Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena es lo sol pòst de gardas dels bòsques que prepausa de dormitòris e de repaisses cauds a mai de camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, e Los Patos prepausan sonque de camping sense servici de restauracion.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Es possible d'obténer de permeses de parc dirèctament al pòst dels gardas del bòsc a Puerto Jiménez, mas accèptan pas las cartas de crèdit
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Lo servici del parc (MINAE) emet pas de permeses pel parc mai d'un mes en avança de l'arribada prevista.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol prepausa un servici de reservacion per una tarifa de 30$ americans, o 10$ per de passes d'un jorn; detalhs sus la pagina de Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Las Islas Cook son un país insular liurament associat amb Nòva Zelanda, situat en Polinesia, al mitan del sud de l'Ocean Pacific.
