eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Es una archipèla de 15 islas espandidas sus mai de 2,2 milions de km² d’ocean.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Amb la meteissa zòna orària que Hawaii, las islas son qualques còps vistas coma un "Hawaii en Oceania".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: E mai s’es mai pichon, fa remembrar Hawaii a qualques visitaires d’edat avançada abans que venguèsse un estat sens totes los grands otèls toristics e autras expansions.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Las Islas Cook an pas cap de vila mas son compausadas de 15 islas diferentas. Las principalas son Rarotonga e Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Dins los païses desvolopats uèi, fornir de lièches e de dejunars de luxe foguèt elevat a una mena de forma d'art.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: A l'extremitat superiora, los B&Bs son plan segur de concurrents essencialament sus doas causas principalas: los lièches e lo dejunar.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: En consequéncia, dins lo melhor d'aqueles establiments òm es capable de trobar la liechariá mai luxuosa, benlèu un plumon fach a man o un lièch antic.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Lo dejunar pòt inclure de delicis sasonièrs de la region o lo plat d'especialitat de l'òste.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: L'encastre podriá èsser un vièlh bastiment istoric amb de mòbles ancians, de jardins plan entretenguts e una piscina.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Intrar dins sa pròpria veitura e se dirigir en destinacion d'una longa rota exercís una atraccion intrinsica de per sa simplicitat.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: A diferéncia dels veïculs mai grands, sètz probablament ja familiarizat amb la conducha de vòstra veitura e ne coneissètz las limitacions.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Plantar una tenda sus una proprietat privada o dins una vila de tota talha pòt atirar aisidament una atencion indesirada.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: En brèu, utilizar vòstra veitura es una manièra excellenta de far un viatge sus la rota mas rarament una manièra d'esperela de far de "campatge".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Lo camping en veitura es possible s'avètz un grand minivan, un SUV, una Sedan o un brèc amb de sètis que s'abaissan.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Qualques otèls an un eiretatge de l'edat daurada del camin de fèrre de vapor e dels paquebòts; abans la Segonda Guèrra Mondiala, durant lo sègle XIX, o a la debuta del sègle XX.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Aquestes otèls èran ont los rics e las celebritats del jorn demoravan, e avián sovent una cosina e una vida nocturna rafinadas.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Los amainatjaments a l'anciana, la manca de las darrièras comoditats e una certa vielhesa graciosa fan tanben partida de son caractèr.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: E mai se son abitualament de proprietat privada, aculhisson d’unes còps que i a de caps d’estat en visita e d’autres dignitaris.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Un viatjaire amb un pilòt d'argent podriá considerar un vòl al torn del mond entièr, brigalhat amb de sojorns dins mantes d’aqueles otèls.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Una ret d'escambi d'ospitalitat es l’organizacion que connècta los viatjaires amb los autoctòns dins las vilas que van visitar.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Rejónher una ret aital demanda pas que d'emplenar abitualament un formulari en linha; encara que qualques rets prepausen o demanden de verificacions complementàrias.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Una lista dels òstes disponibles es puèi fornida siá imprimida e/o en linha, qualques còps amb de referéncias e de vejaires d’autres viatjaires.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing foguèt fondat en genièr de 2004 aprèp que lo programaire informatic Casey Fenton trobèt un vòl bon mercat per Islàndia mas aviá pas cap d'endrech ont demorar.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Escriguèt de mails als estudiants de l’universitat locala e recebèt un nombre impressionant de proposicions de lotjament gratuït.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Las albèrgas se trachan principalament dels joves – un de sos clients tipics es dins la vintena – mas podètz sovent i trobar de personas mai vièlhas tanben.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Las familhas amb d’enfants son un espectacle rar, mas qualques albèrgas los accèptan dins de cambras privadas.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: La vila de Pequín en China serà la vila òsta dels Jòcs Olimpics d’Ivèrn de 2022, çò que ne farà la primièra vila a aver aculhit los Jòcs Olimpics d’estiu e d’ivèrn.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Pequin aculhirà las ceremonias de dobertura e de barrament e las competicions sus glaç interioras.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: D'autras competicions d'esquí se faràn al domeni esquiable de Taizicheng a Zhiangjakou, a aperaquí 220 km (140 milas) de Pequín.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: La màger part dels temples an un festival annal que comença dempuèi novembre e termina a la mitat de mai, e que vària en foncion del calendièr annal de cada temple.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: La màger part dels festivals del temple es celebrada coma una part de l'anniversari del temple o de l'anniversari de la divinitat que presidís o de tot autre eveniment màger associat al temple.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Los festivals del temple de Kerala son fòrça interessants de veire, amb una procession regulara d'elefants decorats, una orquèstra de temple e d'autras festivitats.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Una fièra mondiala (comunament apelada Exposicion Mondiala, o simplament Expo) es un grand festival d’arts e sciéncias internacional.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Los païses qu'i participan presentan d'exposicions artisticas e educativas dins de pabalhons nacionals per expausar de problèmas mondials o la cultura e istòria de lor país.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Las exposicions internacionalas d’orticultura son d’eveniments especializats que presentan d'exposicions floralas, de jardins botanics e tot çò qu'a a veire amb de plantas.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: E mai se en teoria se pòdon debanar annalament (dins la mesura que son dins de païses diferents), dins la practica o son pas.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Aqueles eveniments duran normalament entre tres e sièis meses, e se tenon sus de sits que son pas mai pichons que 50 ectaras.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: I a maites formats de films diferents que son estats utilizats long dels ans. Lo film estandard de 35 mm (negatiu de 36 per 24 mm) es fòrça mai comun.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Pòt abitualament èsser recargat pro aisidament se s'agota, e dona una resolucion gaireben comparabla a un DSLR actual.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: D'unes aparelhs fotografics de format mejan utilizan un format de 6 cm sus 6 cm, mai precisament un negatiu de 56 mm sus 56 mm.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Aquò dona una resolucion de gaireben quatre còps la d’un negatiu 35 mm (3136 mm2 contra 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Los animals salvatges son demest los subjèctes mai complicats per un fotograf e demandan una combinason de bon astre, paciéncia, experiéncia e bon equipament.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Fotografiar d’animals salvatges es sovent pres coma quicòm d’aquesit, pasmens coma la fotografia en general, una fotografia val un milierat de mots.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Fotografiar la fauna demanda sovent un long teleobjectiu, encara que qualques causas coma una volada d’aucèls o una creatura minuscula necessiten d’autres objectius.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Mantes animals exotics son de mal trobar, e d'unes còps que i a los parcs an de règlas a prepaus de la presa de fotografias a usatge comercial.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Los animals salvatges pòdon èsser o timids o agressius. L’environa podriá èsser freja, cauda o mai ostila.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Lo mond ten mai de 5.000 lengas diferentas, e ne compren mai de vint qu’an 50 milions de locutors o mai.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Los mots escriches son sovent mai aisits de comprendre que los mots parlats, tanben. Es particularament verai per las adreças, que son sovent dificilas a prononciar intelligiblament.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Fòrça nacions entièras son completament capablas de parlar en anglés, e dins maitas autras podètz esperar una coneissença limitada - especialament en çò dels joves.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Imaginatz, se volètz, una persona de Manchester, una de Boston, una de Jamaïca e una autra de Sydney assetadas a l'entorn d'una taula a sopar dins un restaurant de Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Se regalan l'un l'autre amb d'istòrias de sas vilas d'origina, dichas dins lors accents distints e lor argòt local.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Crompar de manjar als supermercats es abitualament lo biais mai bon mercat de se noirir. Sens las oportunitats de poder còire, las causidas son pasmens limitadas als aliments ja preparats a manjar.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: De mai en mai, los supermercats tenon una seccion mai variada de plats cosinats. D'unes fornisson a mai un forn microondas o d'autres mejans de caufar los aliments.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Dins qualques païses o tipes de botigas i a almens un restaurant sus plaça, sovent un qu'es pro informal amb de prèses rasonables.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Vos cal far e emportar d'exemplars de vòstra polissa e los detalhs de contacte de vòstre assegurador amb vos.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Devon mostrar l’adreça mail de l’assegurador e de numèros de telefòn internacionals pels conselhs o autorizations e far de reclamacions.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Gardatz-ne un autre exemplar dins vòstres bagatges e en linha (vos mandatz un e-mail amb un fichièr, o estremat dins lo "nívol").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Se viatjatz amb un portable o una tauleta, estrematz-ne una còpia dins sa memòria o sus son disc (accessible sens internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Donatz tanben d'exemplars de vòstres polissas/contactes a vòstres companhons de viatge e a de parents o d’amics d'en çò vòstre dispausats a ajudar.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Los orinhals (tanben coneguts coma alces) son pas inerentament agressius, mas se defendràn se percebon una menaça.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Se las gents creson pas los orinhals sián potencialament perilhoses, se pòdon aprochar tròp prèp e se metre solets en perilh.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Cal beure de bevendas alcoolizadas amb moderacion. L'alcoòl afècta cadun diferentament, e conéisser sos limits es fòrça important.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Los problèmas de santat possibles a long tèrme per encausa d'una consomacion excessiva d'alcoòl pòdon inclure de lesions del fetge e mai la cecitat e la mòrt. Lo perilh potencial creis quand se consoma d'alcoòl produch illegalament.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Los espiritoses illegals pòdon contenir divèrsas impuretats perilhosas, comprenent lo metanòl, que pòt provocar la cecitat o la mòrt e mai amb de dòsis pichonas.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Las lunetas pòdon èsser mens caras dins un país estrangièr, especialament dins los païses de bas salari ont los còstes del trabalh son mai basses.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Vos cal envisatjar de passar un examèn ocular a l'ostal, particularament se l'assegurança o cobrís, e de portar l'ordenança per que siá depausada endacòm mai.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Los quadres de marcas de luxe disponibles dins d'airals aital pòdon presentar dos problèmas; d'unes pòdon èsser d'imitacions, e los vertadièrs que son importats pòdon èsser mai cars qu'en çò sieu.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Lo cafè es una de las mercadariás mai escambiada dins lo mond entièr, e ne podètz probablament trobar mantas menas dins vòstra region d'origina.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Pr'aquò, i a mantes biaisses distintius de beure lo cafè dins lo mond entièr que valon la pena d'ensajar.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Lo canyoning (o: canyoneering) es lo fach de davalar al fons d'un canyon, qu'es o sec o plen d'aiga.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Lo canyoning combina d'elements de la natacion, de l'escalada e del saut--mas demanda relativament pauc d'entrainament o de forma fisica per començar (comparat amb l'escalada, la natacion sosmarina o l'esquí alpin, per exemple).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: La caminada es una activitat exteriora que consistís a caminar dins d'environas naturalas, sovent sus de pistas per caminar.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Caminar de jorn implica de distàncias de mens d'una mila fins a de distàncias que pòdon èsser percorregudas en un sol jorn.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Per una caminada d'un jorn sus una pista facila pauc de preparacions son necitas, e tota persona moderadament en forma ne pòt profechar.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Las familhas amb d’enfants pichonets pòdon aver mestièr de mai de preparacion, mas un jorn a l'exterior es aisidament possible e mai amb de nenons e los enfants d'edat preescolara.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Internacionalament, i a gaireben 200 organizacions que fan de visitas toristicas. La màger part d’elas foncionan independentament.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Lo successor de Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours a una ret de dotzenas de fornisseires de visitas guidadas sus quatre continents.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Amb sas rasics dins lo Running Tours Barcelona de Barcelona e lo Running Copenhagen de Copenaga, foguèt rapidament rejonch per Running Tours Prague basat a Praga e d’autres.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: I a fòrça causas que vos cal considerar abans e quand viatjatz endacòm.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Quand viatjatz, esperatz pas que las causas sián pas coma o son "a l'ostal". Las manièras, las leis, lo manjar, la circulacion, lo lotjament, los estandards, la lenga e mai de causas encara diferiràn fins a cèrt ponch d’ont vivètz.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Aquò es quicòm que vos cal totjorn gardar a l’esperit, per evitar una decepcion o benlèu mai un descòr a prepaus del biais local de far las causas.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Las agéncias de viatge existisson dempuèi lo sègle XIX. Un agent de viatge es abituament una bona opcion per un viatge que d'estend mai enlà de l’experiéncia anteriora amb la natura, la cultura, la lenga o los païses de revenguts febles d'un viatjaire.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: E mai se la màger part de las agéncias son dispausadas a prendre en carga la màger part de las reservacions regularas, mantes agents s’especializan dins de tipes particulars de viatge, forquetas de budget o de destinacions.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Pòt èsser melhor d’utilizar un agent que resèrva frequentament de viatges semblables als vòstres.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Getatz un còp d'uèlh als viatges que l'agent presenta, que siá sus un sit web o a la veirina d'una botiga.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Se volètz veire lo mond a bon prètz, per necessitat, estil de vida o desfís, i a qualques biaisses d'o far.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Basicament, van dins doas categorias: O trabalhatz del temps que viatjatz o ensajatz de limitar vòstras despensas. Aqueste article se centra sul darrièr cas.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Per aqueles que son dispausats a sacrificar de confòrt, de temps e de predictabilitat per far davalar las despensas a ras de zèro, veire budget minimum de viatge.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Aqueste conselh supausa que los viatjaires rauban pas, fan pas d'intrusions, participan pas a de mercats illegals, mendican pas o explòtan pas d'autras personas per lors pròpris beneficis.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Un ponch de contraròtle doanièr es abitualament lo primièr arrèst quand desembarcam d’un avion, un batèu, o d’un autre veicul.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Dins qualques trens transfrontalièrs d'inspeccions son fachas quand lo tren es en marcha e deuriatz aver un document d'identitat valid amb vos quand montatz dins un d’aqueles trens.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Dins los trens-lièches de nuèch, los passapòrts pòdon èsser reculhits pel conductor per tal qu'ajatz pas vòstre sòm interromput.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: L'enregistrament es une exigéncia addicionala pel procès de visa. Dins certans païses, devètz enregistrar vòstra preséncia e l'adrèça ont demoratz en çò de las autoritats localas.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Aquò podriá demandar d‘emplenar un formulari al prèp de la polícia locala o de far una visita als burèus d’immigracion.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Dins mantes païses amb de talas leis, los otèls locals geriràn l'enregistrament (doblidatz pas d'o demandar).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Dins d’autres cases, sonque aqueles que demòran a l'exterior dels lotjaments toristics se devon enregistrar. Pasmens, aquò fa la lei plan mai fosca, e doncas vos o cal descobrir en avança.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: L’arquitectura se tracha de la concepcion e de la construccion dels bastiments. L’arquitectura d’un endrech es sovent una atraccion toristica d'esperela.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Mantes immòbles son fòrça polits a agachar e la vista dempuèi un immòble bèl o dempuèi una fenèstra posicionada intelligentament pòt èsser una beutat a contemplar.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: L’arquitectura cavalca d'un biais considerable d’autres domenis coma la planificacion urbana, l’engenhariá civila, los arts decoratius, lo design d’interior e l’amainatjament del païsatge.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Pr'amor de la granda distància de fòrça pueblos, auretz pas l'escasença de trobar una quantitat significativa de vida nocturna sens viatjar a Albuquerque o a Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Pasmens, gaireben totes los casinòs marcats sus la lista çai-sus servisson de bevendas, e mai d'unes prepausan de divertiments de marcas (principalament los grands qu'enròdan immediatament Albuquerque e Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Mèfi: aicí los bars de las pichonas vilas son pas totjorn de bons endreches pel visitaire de defòra l'estat per s'i rabalar.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Una causa es segura, lo nòrd de Nòu Mexic a de problèmas significatius amb la conducha en ebrietat, e la concentracion de conductors ebris es nauta prèp dels bars de las vilòtas pichonas.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Las pinturas o escrivalhas muralas indesirablas son conegudas coma de grafitis.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Encara que siá luènh d’èsser un fenomèn modèrn, la màger part de las gents probablament o assòcian a de joves que vandalizan la proprietat publica e privada en emplegar de pintura en aerosòl.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Pasmens, actualament, i a d'artistas de grafitis confirmats, d'eveniments de grafitis e d'unes murs "legals". Las pinturas de grafitis revèrtan sovent dins aqueste contèxt a d'òbras d'art puslèu qu'a de tags illegibles.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Lo lançament de bomerang es una competéncia populara que mantes toristas vòlon aquesir.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Se volètz aprendre a lançar un bomerang que torne a vòstra man, asseguratz-vos d'aver un bomerang apropriat per que torne.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: La màger part dels bomerangs disponibles en Austràlia son en realitat non tornants. Es melhor pels començaires de pas ensajar de los getar dins lo vent.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Un repais se còi dins un clòt ardent dins lo sòl.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: La fòssa es siá caufada amb de pèiras caudas d'un fòc o, dins qualques endreches, la calor geotermica fa que las zònas del sòl sián naturalament caudas.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Lo hangi es sovent utilizat per còire un rostit per un sopar d'estil tradicional.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Divèrses endreches a Rotorua prepausan de hangis geotermics, mentre que d'autres hangis se pòdon assajar a Christchurch, Wellington e endacòm mai.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail a doas classas de trens de correspondéncia dins e a l'entorn de la vila del Cap: MetroPlus (tanben sonat Primièra Classa) e Metro (sonat Tresena Classa).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus es mai confortable e mens plen de monde mas leugièrament mai car, e mai s'es encara mai bon mercat que las bilhetas normalas de mètro en Euròpa.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Totes los trens an a l’encòp de vagons MetroPlus e Metro; los vagons MetroPlus son totjorn a la fin del tren la mai pròcha de la vila del Cap.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Portar per d'autres - Vos cal pas jamai laissar vòstres bagatges luènh de vòstra vista, particularament quand sètz a passar de frontièras internacionalas.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Vos podriatz trobar essent utilizat coma un portaire de dròga sens o saber, çò que vos menarà dins una bèla quantitat de problèmas.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Aquò compren esperar en linha, estent que se podrián utilizar de gosses que solfinan la dròga o en quin moment que siá sens avertiment.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: D'unes païses an de castigs extrèmament draconians e mai per las primièras infraccions; aquestes pòdon inclure de penas de preson de mai de 10 ans o la mòrt.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Las sacas daissadas sens susvelhança son una tòca pels raubaires e pòdon tanben atirar l’atencion de las autoritats socitosas de las menaças de bombas.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: A l'ostal, pr'amor d’aquesta exposicion constanta als gèrmes locals, las probabilitats son fòrça elevadas que siatz ja immunizats a eles.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Mas dins d'autras parts del mond, ont la fauna bacteriologica es novèla per vos, es mai probable que poscatz aver de problèmas.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Tanben, dins de climats mai cauds las bacterias creisson mai rapidament e a l'encòp subrevivon mai de temps a l’exterior del còrs.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: E doncas las plagas de l'estomac de Delhi, la malediccion del faraon, la revenja de Montezuma, e lors amics nombroses.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Coma pels problèmas respiratòris dins de climats mai freges, los problèmas intestinals dins los climats cauds son relativament frequents e son dins la màger part dels cases netament embestiants mas pas vertadièrament dangieroses.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Se viatjatz a un país en desvolopament pel primièr còp – o dins una part novèla del mond – vos cal pas sosestimar lo chòc cultural potencial.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Fòrça viatjaires experimentats e capables son estats estabosits per lo despaïsament  pendent de viatges dins lo mond en desvolopament, ont de pichonas variacions culturalas se pòdon apondre rapidament.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Subretot pendent vòstres primièrs jorns, vos cal considerar de far de foliás dins los otèls, de cosina e de servicis d'estil occidental e de qualitat per vos ajudar a vos aclimatar.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Cal pas dormir sus un matalàs o sus una palhassa al sòl dins d'airals ont coneissètz pas la fauna locala.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: S'anatz campar, portatz un lièch de camp o un amac per vos tenir a distància de las sèrps, dels escorpions e d'autres.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Emplenatz vòstre ostal amb un cafè ric lo matin e qualque tè relaxant de camomilha de nuèch.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Quand sètz en vacanças a l'ostal, avètz léser de vos far plaser e de prendre qualques minutas suplementàrias per vos preparar quicòm d’especial.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Se vos sentissètz pus aventurós, profechatz d'aquesta escasença per vos preparar un chuc o una barreja de qualques smoothies.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Benlèu descobriretz una simpla bevenda que podètz preparar pel dejunar quand tornatz a vòstra rotina quotidiana.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Se vivètz dins una vila qu'a una cultura de consomacion de beure variada, vos cal anar dins los bars o los pubs dins de barris que frequentatz pas.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Per aqueles que son pas familiarizats amb lo jargon medical, los mots infecciós e contagiós an de significacions distintas.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Una malautiá infecciosa es una malautiá qu’es causada per un patogèn, coma un virus, una bacteria, un fong o d’autres parasits.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Una malautiá contagiosa es una malautiá qu’es transmesa aisidament en essent dins lo vesinatge d’una persona infectada.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Fòrça govèrns demandan als visitaires qu'intran dins lors païses, o als residents que se'n van, d'èsser vaccinats contra tota una tièra de malautiás.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Aquestas exigéncias pòdon sovent dependre de quines païses lo viatjaire a visitat o a l'intencion de visitar.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Un dels ponches fòrts de Charlotte, en Carolina del Nòrd, es qu'a una abondància d'opcions de qualitat nauta per las familhas.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Los residents d'autras regions citan sovent la convivialitat per la familha coma una rason primordiala per s'i installar, e los visitaires tròban sovent que la vila es de bon profechar amb d'enfants.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Dins los darrièrs 20 ans, la quantitat d'opcions pensadas pels enfants dins Uptown Charlotte a crescut exponencialament.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Los taxis son generalament pas emplegats per las familhas a Charlotte, e mai se pòdon èsser de qualque utilitat dins cèrtas circonstàncias.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: I a un suplement per aver mai de 2 passatgièrs, e doncas aquesta opcion podriá èsser mai cara que çò necessari.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antartida es l’endrech mai freg de la Tèrra, e enròda lo Pòl Sud.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Las visitas toristicas son costosas, demandan una bona forma fisica, se pòdon debanar sonque en estiu de novembre a febrièr, e son grandament limitadas a la peninsula, las islas e la Mar de Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Un parelh de milièrs d'emplegats vivon aquí durant l’estiu dins qualques quatre dotzenas de basas mai que mai dins aqueles ròdols; un nombre pichon i demòra pendent l’ivèrn.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: L'Antartida interiora es un planastèl desolat cobèrt per 2-3 km de glaç.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: D'excursions aerianas especializadas ocasionalas van cap a l'interior del país, per l'alpinisme o per aténher lo Pòl, qu'a una granda basa.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: La travèrsa del pòl Sud (o autorota) es una pista de 1600 km que va dempuèi l'estacion de McMurdo sus la Mar de Ross fins al pòl.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Es de nèu compactada amb de crebassas emplenadas e marcadas per de bandièras. Pòt èsser sonque traversada per de tractors especializats, de tirassas de transpòrt amb de carburant e de provisions.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Aquestes son pas fòrça agils e doncas la pista deu prendre un long bestorn a l'entorn de las montanhas transantarticas per arribar al planastèl.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: La causa mai comuna dels accidents en ivèrn son las rotas lisantas, los trepadors (trepadors) e particularament las grasas.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Coma minimum, avètz besonh de sabatas amb de sòlas adaptadas. Las sabatas d’estiu son abitualament fòrça resquilhosas sul glaç e la nèu, e mai qualques bòtas d’ivèrn son pas apropriadas.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Lo motiu deuriá èsser pro prigond, 5 mm (1/5 poce) o mai, e lo material pro doç a de temperaturas frejas.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Qualques bòtas an de rampons e i a un equipament suplementari amb de clavèls per las condicions lisantas, adaptat a la màger part de las sabatas e de bòtas, pels talons o los talons e la sòla.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Los talons deurián èsser basses e amples. La sabla, la grava o la sal (clorur de calci) es sovent escampilhada sus las rotas o los camins per melhorar la traccion.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Las avalancas son pas una anomalia; las pendas abruptas pòdon tenir solament una quantitat limitada de nèu, e los volums en excès davalaràn jos la forma d'avalancas.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Lo problèma es que la nèu es pegosa e doncas a besonh d'un desencadenament per davalar, mas un pauc de nèu que davala pòt èsser l'eveniment que desencadenarà la rèsta.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: D'unes còps que i a l'eveniment original qu'o precipita tot es lo solelh que caufa la nèu, d'autres còps qualques nevadas de mai, e qualques còps d'autres eveniments naturals, sovent un uman.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Una tornada es una colomna viradissa d’aire de pression fòrça bassa, que chuca l’aire que l'enròda cap a l'interior e amondaut.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Genèran de vents fòrts (sovent 100-200 milas/ora) e pòdon soslevar d’objèctes pesucs dins l’aire, e los emportar del temps que la tornada se mòu.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Començan coma d'embuts que davalan de nívols de tempèstas, e venon de "tornadas" tre que tòcan lo sòl.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Los fornisseires de VPN personals (ret privada virtuala) son un biais excellent de contornar a l'encòp la censura politica e lo geofiltratge IP comercial.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Son superiors als mandataris de webs per divèrsas rasons. Desrotan tot lo trafic Internet, pas sonque l'http.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Prepausan normalament de bendas passantas mai amplas e de melhoras qualitats de servici. Son criptadas e doncas mai dificilas a espionar.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Las companhiás de mejans de comunicacion mentisson d'un biais rotinièr a prepaus de la tòca d'aquò, en afirmant qu'es per "evitar lo piratatge".
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: De fach, los còdis regionals an absoludament pas cap d'efièch sul copiatge illegal; una còpia bit a bit d'un disc foncionarà just coma cal sus tota mena de dispositiu ont o fa l'original.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: L'objectiu real es de donar a aquelas companhiás mai de contraròtle sus lors mercats; tot vira a l'entorn de l'argent.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Estent que las telefonadas son endralhadas per Internet, avètz pas besonh d’utilizar una companhiá telefonica situada ont demoratz o ont viatjatz.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: I a pas tanpauc d'obligacion d'obtenir un numèro local de la comunitat on vivètz; podètz obtenir una conneccion per satellit a Internet dins las regions salvatjas de Chicken, Alaska e seleccionar un numèro qu'afirma que sètz dins l’Arizòna assolelhada.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Sovent, vos cal crompar un numèro mondial separadament que permet als telefòn PSTN de vos sonar. D'ont es lo numèro fa una diferéncia per las gents que vos telefonan.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Las aplicacions de traduccion de tèxt en temps real - d'aplicacions que son capablas de revirar automaticament de segments entièrs de tèxt d'una lenga a una autra.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: D'unas aplicacions d'aquesta categoria pòdon e mai traduire de tèxtes en lengas estrangièras sus de panèls o d'autres objèctes dins lo mond real quand l'utilizaire dirigís l'smartphone cap a aqueles objèctes.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Los motors de traduccion se son melhorats bèlament, e donan sovent ara de traduccions mai o mens corrèctas (e mai rarament de charabiat), mas cal encara far atencion, que se pòdon enganar completament.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Una de las aplicacions mai proeminentas dins aquesta categoria es Google Translate, que permet de traduccion fòra linha aprèp aver descargat las donadas de la lenga desiradas.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Emplegar d’aplicacions de navegacion de GPS sus vòstre smartphone pòt èsser lo biais ma aisit e mai practic de s’orientar quand sètz defòra de vòstre país d’origina.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Pòt permetre d'estalviar de moneda al moment de crompar de mapas novèlas per un GPS, o un dispositiu GPS autonòm o de ne logar un a una companhiá de locacions de veituras.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: S'avètz pas de conneccion de donadas sus vòstre telefòn, o qu'es defòra de portada, lors performàncias pòdon èsser limitadas o indisponiblas.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Totas las botigas e mai las pichonas son claufidas d'un desplegament desconcertant de cartas telefonicas prepagadas que pòdon èsser utilizadas dempuèi de telefòns de pagament o de telefòns ordinaris.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: E mai se la màger part de las cartas son bonas per telefonar ont que siá, d’unas que i a son especializadas per porgir de tarifas telefonicas favorablas a de grops especifics de païses.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: L'accès a aqueles servicis se fa sovent a travèrs d'un numèro telefonic gratuït que pòt èsser sonat a partir de la màger part de telefòns sens còst.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Las règlas que concernisson la fotografia ordinària s'aplican tanben a l'enregistrament vidèo, possiblament encara mai.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Se far pas qu'una fòto de quicòm es pas permés, alara deuriatz pas pensar nimai a n'enregistrar un vidèo.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: S'utilizatz un dròn, verificatz plan en avança çò que vos es autorizat de filmar e quines permeses o licéncias suplementàrias son necessaris.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Fa volar un dròn al costat d'un aeropòrt o sus una multitud es gaireben totjorn una idèa marrida, e mai s’es pas illegal dins vòstre airal.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Uèi viatjar en avion es sonque rarament reservat dirèctament a travèrs de la companhiá aeriana sens cercar e comparar los prèses d'en primièr.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: D'unes còps que i a lo meteis vòl pòt aver de prèses bravament diferents sus divèrses agregadors e val la pena de comparar los resultats de cerca e d'agachar tanben lo sit web de la companhiá aeriana abans de reservar.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: E mai s’avètz benlèu pas besonh d’un visa per de cortas visitas dins cèrtes païses coma torista o pels afars, i anar coma estudiant internacional demanda generalament un sojorn mai long qu’i anar tot just coma un torista ocasional.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: En general, demorar dins tot país estrangièr durant un periòde plan long de temps vos demandarà d’obtenir un visa en avança.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Los visas d'estudiants an generalament d'exigéncias e de proceduras de demanda diferentas dels visas de torisme o d'afars normals.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Per la màger part dels païses, auretz mestièr d’una letra d'invitacion de l’institucion ont desiratz estudiar, e tanben una pròva de finançament per subvenir a vòstres besonhs per almens la primièra annada de vòstres estudis.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Vos cal verificar amb l'institucion, e tanben amb lo departament d'immigracion del país ont desiratz estudiar per conéisser las exigéncias precisas.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Levat se sètz un diplomata, trabalhar otramar significa generalament que vos caldrà declarar los impòstes sul revengut dins lo país ont sètz basat.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: L'impòst sul revengut es estructurat diferentament dins diferents païses, e los tausses e escalons d'imposicion vàrian considerablament d'un país a l'autre.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Dins qualques païses federals, coma los Estats Units e Canadà, los impòstes sul revengut son prelevats a l’encòp al nivèl federal e al nivèl local, alara los nivèls e los escalons d'imposicion pòdon variar de region a region.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: E mai se los contraròtles d’immigracion son abitualament inexistents o una formalitat quand arribatz dins vòstre país, los contraròtles de la doana pòdon èsser un maldecap.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Asseguratz-vos de saber çò que podètz e podètz pas emportar e declaratz tot çò qu'es enlà dels limits legals.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Lo biais mai aisit de començar l'entrepresa de l'escritura de viatges es d'afinar vòstras competéncias sus un sit web blòg de viatge reconegut.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Aprèp que vos sentiretz d'aise per formatar e editar sul web, mai tard alara, podriatz crear vòstre pròpri sit web.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Far de volontariat mentre que viatjam es un biais fantastic de crear la diferéncia mas s'agís pas sonque de donar.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Viure e far de benevolat dins un país estrangièr es una bona manièra d'aver l'escasença d'aprendre una cultura diferenta, d'encontrar de personas novèlas, d'aprendre de causas sus vos, d'obtenir un sens de la perspectiva e mai aquesir de novèlas competéncias.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Pòt èsser tanben un bon biais d'estirar un budget per se permetre un sojorn mai long endacòm estent que mantes trabalhs dins lo volontariat fornisson cambra e pension e d'unes pagan un pichon salari.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Los vikings utilizavan las vias navegablas russas per arribar a la Mar Negra e a la Mar Caspiana. De porcions d’aqueles itineraris pòdon encara èsser utilizadas. Verificatz los possibles besonhs de permeses especials, los quals pòdon èsser de mal obtenir.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Lo Canal Mar Blanca–Baltica connècta l’Ocean Artic a la Mar Baltica, via lo lac Onega, lo lac Ladoga e Sant Petersborg, subretot per de flums e de lacs.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Lo lac Onega es tanben connectat a Vòlga, e doncas arribar de la Mar Caspiana a travèrs de Russia es encara possible.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Vos cal assegurar qu'un còp que passatz per las marinas tot serà fòrça evident. Encontraretz d’autres rodaires d'embarcacions e partejaràn sas informacions amb vos.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Basicament penjaretz d'afichas per prepausar vòstra ajuda, caminaretz suls embarcadors, vos sarraretz de las personas que netejan sos iòts, en ensajant d’establir lo contacte amb los marinièrs dins lo bar, etc.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Assajatz de parlar al mai de personas coma siá possible. Aprèp un moment tot lo monde vos coneisserà e vos balharà d’indicas sus quin batèu se cerca qualqu’un.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Vos caldriá causir vòstra companhiá aeriana coma Viatjaire Aerian Frequent dins una aliança amb atencion.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: E mai se podètz pensar qu'es intuitiu de rejónher la companhiá aeriana amb la quala volatz mai, vos caldriá èsser conscient que los privilègis ofèrts son sovent diferents e que los ponches de viatjaire frequent pòdon èsser mai generoses amb una companhiá aeriana diferenta dins la meteissa aliança.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: De companhiás aerianas coma Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways e Turkish Airlines an espandit grandament sos servicis devers Africa, e prepausan de correspondéncias a maitas vilas importantas africanas a de tarifas mai competitivas que d’autras vilas europèas.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines vòla cap a 39 destinacions dins 30 païses africans en 2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: S'avètz de temps de viatge suplementari, verificatz cossí vòstra tarifa totala per Africa se compara a una tarifa a l'entorn del mond.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Vos cal pas oblidar d'ajustar los còstes suplementaris dels visas addicionals, las taxas de partença, los transpòrts terrèstres, etc. per totes aqueles endreches en defòra d'Africa.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Se volètz volar a travèrs del mond completament dins l'emisfèri sud, la causida dels vòls e de las destinacions es limitada per encausa de la manca de rotas transoceanicas.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Cap de companhiá aeriana de l'aliança cobrís las traversadas de totes tres oceans dins l'Emisfèri Sud (e SkyTeam cobrís pas cap de las traversadas).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Pasmens, Star Alliance o cobrís tot levat lo Pacific Sud oriental de Santiago de Chile a Tahiti, qu'es un vòl LATAM Oneworld.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Aqueste vòl es pas la soleta opcion se volètz sautar lo Pacific Sud e la còsta occidentala d’America del Sud. (veire çai-jos)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: En 1994, la region d'Azerbaitjan etnicament armènia de Nagorno-Karabakh declarèt la guèrra contra los azèris.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Amb lo sosten armèni, una republica novèla foguèt creada. Pasmens, cap de nacion reconeguda – quitament pas l'Armènia – la reconeis pas oficialament.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: De disputas diplomaticas a prepaus de la region contunhan de maganhar las relacions entre Armènia e Azerbaitjan.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Lo barri dels canals (en neerlandés: Grachtengordel) es lo celèbre barri del sègle XVII qu'enròda lo Binnenstad d'Amsterdam.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Lo districte entièr es designat coma un Sit del Patrimòni Mondial de l’UNESCO per encausa de sa valor cultura e istorica unica, e sas valors de proprietat son demest las mai elevadas del país.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, que significa Cinc Tèrras, compren los cinc vilatges litorals de Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza e Monterosso situats dins la region italiana de Ligúria.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Figuran sus la lista del Patrimòni Mondial de l’UNESCO.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Long dels sègles, las gents an bastit amb suènh de faissas sul païsatge rufe e abrupte fins als bauces que susvelhan las aigas.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Una part de son agradatge es la manca de desvolopament corporatiiu visible. Los camins, los trens e las embarcacions ligan los vilatges, e las veituras i pòdon pas arribar de l'exterior.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Las varietats del francés que son parladas en Belgica e en Soïssa diferisson leugièrament del francés parlat en França, encara que sián pro similaras per èsser mutualament intelligiblas.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Lo sistèma de numerotacion, en particular, en Belgica e Soïssa francofònas a qualques peculiaritats leugièras que son diferentas del francés parlat en França, e la prononciacion de qualques mots es leugièrament diferenta.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Pr'aquò, totes los bèlgas e soïsses francofòns aurián aprés lo francés estandard a l'escòla, e doncas serián capables de vos comprendre e mai s'emplegatz lo sistèma estandard francés de numeracion.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Dins fòrça partidas del mond, bolegar la man es un gèst amistós, qu'indica "adieu."
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Pasmens, en Malaisia, almens demest los malais dins d'airals rurals, significa "ven aicí," semblable a l'indèx plegat cap al còrs, un gèst qu'es emplegat dins cèrtes païses occidentals, e deuriá èsser emplegat sonque amb aquel objectiu.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: D'un biais semblant un viatjaire britanic en Espanha pòt malinterpretar un gèst d'adieu qu'utiliza la pauma en fàcia a la persona que fa lo gèst (puslèu que cap a la persona a qui se fa signe) coma un gèst per tornar.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Las lengas auxiliaras son de lengas artificialas o construchas creadas amb l'intencion de facilitar la comunicacion entre de gents qu’aurián autrament de dificultats per comunicar.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Son distintas de las linguas francas, las qualas son de lengas naturalas o organicas que venon dominantas per una rason o una autra coma mejan de comunicacion entre de locutors d’autras lengas.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Durant la calor de la jornada, los viatjaires pòdon veire de miratges que donan l’illusion d’aiga (o d’autras causas).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Aquestes pòdon èsser perilhoses se lo viatjaire seguís lo miratge, degalhant una energia preciosa e l'aiga que demòra.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Quitament lo mai caud dels desèrts pòt venir extrèmament freg de nuèch. L'ipotermia es una risca vertadièra sens vestimenta cauda.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Durant l’estiu, especialament, vos caldrà mesfisar dels moissals se decidissètz de vos passejar a travèrs de la selva tropicala.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: E mai se condusissètz a travèrs de la selva sostropicala, qualques segondas amb las pòrtas obèrtas mentre dintratz dins lo veïcul son de temps sufisent per que los moissals monten dins lo veïcul amb vos.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: La gripa dels aucèls, o mai formalament la gripa aviària, pòt infectar a l’encòp los aucèls e los mamifèrs.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Mens d'un milièr de cases son estats raportats en çò dels umans, mas d’unes son estats mortals.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: La màger part a afectat de personas que trabalha amb la polalha, mas i a tanben qualques riscas pels observaires d'aucèls.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Son tipics de Norvègia los fjords esquius e las vals que donan passatge subtament a un naut planastèl mai o mens unifòrme.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Aquestes planastèls son sovent designats coma de "vidde" çò que significa un espaci obèrt, vast, sens arbres, un espandi sens limits.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: In Rogaland e Agder son sonats abitualament "hei" çò que vòl dire una landa sens arbre sovent cobèrta de bruc.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Los glacièrs son pas estables, mas davalan per la montanha. Aquò causarà de fendasclas, de crebassas, que pòdon èsser escuresidas pels ponts de nèu.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Los murs e las vòutas de las espelugas de glaç se pòdon escrancar e las frachas se pòdon tampar.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Al cap dels glacièrs de blòcs enòrmes se destacan, tomban e benlèu sautan o rodelan mai luènh de la poncha.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: La sason toristica per las estacions dels puèges atenh son ponch mai naut generalament pendent l’estiu indian.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Pasmens, an un genre diferent de beutat e d'embelinament durant l'ivèrn, amb mantas estacions de montanha que recebon de quantitats sanas de nèus e que prepausan d'activitats talas coma l'esquí e lo snowboard.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Sonque qualques companhiás aerianas prepausan encara de tarifas de dòl, las qualas donan una reduccion leugièra sul còst dels viatges funeraris de darrièra minuta.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Las companhiás aerianas que las prepausan comprenon Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa per de vòls que partisson dempuèi los Estats Units o Canadà, e WestJet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Dins totes los cases, vos cal reservar per telefòn dirèctament amb la companhiá aeriana.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
